programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We follow the rescue of a baby elephant. Once rescued, it will be transported by plane to the breeding station and raised with love and commitment. In order to satisfy the little pachyderm's urge to move while in the breeding station, there is sometimes an adorable football match between the animals.

programme.title: Elephants: Back to the Wild
programme.desc: We accompany the first steps of a two-year-old elephant who is just starting his release program. We also observe the story of two young elephants in their first night in the wilderness on their own. Captivating film footage allows us to truly learn how elephants behave in the wild.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: glCuba
programme.desc: Even anyone who has not yet been to Cuba can conjure up certain images of American vintage street cruisers, imposing buildings that have seen better days, white sandy beaches full of palms and loving couples on the Malecón against a backdrop of crashing waves. This island is somewhat of a myth and its people generate a special joie de vivre. The legendary Hershey Train departs for Matanzas from the capital, Havana. On the oldest electrified railway line in the Caribbean, 60-year-old Spanish carriages make their way along al-most 100 kilometres of coastline in the most relaxed way possible. The Salvavidas on Varadero, probably the most famous beach on the island, have a particular-ly beautiful workplace. The lifeguards' territory ex-tends for more than 20 kilometres. In order to protect the coasts of Cuba, mangroves have been replanted here for many years. The project is supported by the UN and planting is often carried out by schoolchildren. In doing so, Cuban children learn how to treat their maritime habitat in a sustainable fashion. The former colonial city of Trinidad on Cuba's south coast is gen-erally considered to be one of the most beautiful places in the entire Caribbean. The houses here are particular-ly colourful. A plethora of magnificent buildings can be seen at the Plaza Mayor, the neo-baroque main square.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these car routes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured!

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto the dangerous roads of Afghanistan's Hindu Kush Mountains, the infamous Moloto Road in South Africa, along the vertiginous slopes of the Bolivian Andes and other "roads of death" in India, Georgia and the Ivory Coast

programme.title: Dream Islands Of Europe: Capri, Ischia and Procida
programme.desc: Capri and Ischia are world famous. From Naples, it's just a short hop over to the two islands. Perfect destinations, then, for a week's cruise along the Gulf of Naples and the adjoining Amalfi Coast to the south. There, Positano, Amalfi or Salerno as well as a handful of other mostly small harbor towns are extremely worthwhile destinations.

programme.desc: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone.

programme.title: Never 2 Big
programme.desc: Freddy (Shemar Moore) is a big-shot music industry executive, whose cousin, Blusette (Salli Richardson), is a successful and well-known singer managed by 8-Ball Harris (Ernie Hudson). Blusette soon realizes, however, that 8-Ball is a small-time crook, hoping to use her and her renown to benefit his various schemes. Blusette tells him to take a hike, and she turns up dead a short while later. Freddy then tries to uncover the truth about Blusette, while 8-Ball works to frame him.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: A beautiful woman (Marie Avgeropoulos) helps a New York bicycle messenger (Taylor Lautner) who's in hot water with a group of gangsters.

programme.title: Beat Street
programme.desc: At the forefront of early hip-hop culture, DJ Kenny Kirkland (Guy Davis), his B-boy brother, Lee (Robert Taylor), and graffiti artist Ramon (John Chardiet) all have hopes of showcasing their talents outside the confines of South Bronx, N.Y. When Tracy Carlson (Rae Dawn Chong), a composer and choreographer, runs into Kirkland and Lee at one of Manhattan's hottest nightclubs, she offers Lee an opportunity to perform on TV. However, the crew has a long way to go before achieving their dreams.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Derniers préparatifs
programme.desc: Takato et ses compagnons prennent une grave décision : ils vont plonger dans le Digimonde pour aller sauver l'un des leurs, qui a été kidnappé par l'ennemi. Les Digi-dompteurs vont devoir affronter le plus grand des défis : leur famille...

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Un nouveau digimonde
programme.desc: Plongée dans le Digimonde ! Takato, Jen, Ruki, Juri, Hirokazu et Kenta partent à l'aventure ! Bien vite, les enfants et les Digimon doivent se scinder en deux groupes. Dans ce monde hostile et inconnu, cela n'augure rien de bon...

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Kazu et Kenta en action
programme.desc: Le groupe de Ruki, Kenta et Hirokazu essuie une tempête de données ! Il faut vite trouver un abri. Hirokazu et Kenta, qui rêvent toujours de devenir Digi-dompteurs, sont fascinés par leur rencontre avec deux Digimon.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: La moto folle
programme.desc: Le groupe de Takato, Jen et Juri finit par atteindre un village qui semble abandonné. Les habitants se cachent, car ils sont persécutés par une moto folle ! Impmon, quant à lui, se voit proposer un marché qu'il a du mal à refuser...

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Pauvre Ryo
programme.desc: Ruki essaie d'avancer, mais elle est ralentie par Kenta et Hirokazu, qui ne songent qu'à s'amuser. Soudain, un nouvel éclair de lumière téléporte tout ce petit monde dans une nouvelle dimension, où Ruki retrouve un visage familier...

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Goliath
programme.desc: Les enfants se retrouvent enfin ! Mais Ruki et Renamon manquent à l'appel. Ryo se sent coupable... Une nouvelle menace surgit et CyberDramon, le compagnon de Ryo, est bien décidé à lutter contre. Et ce, même au mépris des ordres de son dompteur.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Un orage surprise
programme.desc: Hypnos est réactivé ! Ruki et Renamon retrouvent Kurumon. Après bien des péripéties, le petit groupe tombe sur Beelzemon. Renamon comprend vite qu'il s'agit là d'Impmon, qui s'est digivolvé. Un terrible combat commence.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Les progrès de Kazu
programme.desc: Andromon est bien mal en point ! Mais Hirokazu est bien décidé à prendre soin du Digimon. Il négocie avec les Geckomon du village pour avoir un peu de données. Andromon, reconnaissant, décide d'accepter Hirokazu comme Digi-dompteur !

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Shibumi explique
programme.desc: Takato et ses compagnons sont menacés par la montée des eaux ! Heureusement, Jen remarque quelque chose qui va leur permettre à tous de s'échapper. Parallèlement, Takato, Jen et Terriermon en apprennent plus sur les origines de Guilmon.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Le coup du lapin
programme.desc: Un portail vers le Digimonde s'ouvre juste devant la petite sœur de Jen. En voyant Terriermon s'engouffrer dedans, la petite fille n'hésite pas un seul instant. Elle le suit ! Quelles rencontres va-t-elle faire, dans ce monde inconnu ?

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Cœur de lionne
programme.desc: Beelzemon est de retour ! C'est une très mauvaise nouvelle pour les Digi-dompteurs et leurs compagnons, qui ne sont pas de taille. Même Growlmon ne fait pas le poids. Alors que les Digimon tombent les un après les autres, Leomon s'avance.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Takato se fâche
programme.desc: Takato est fou de colère après ce qui est arrivé au brave Leomon. Il pousse Guilmon à se digivolver encore plus et Megidramon apparaît. Mais même Megidramon n'est pas de taille face à Beelzemon. Que peut faire Takato ?

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Un terrible combat
programme.desc: Dukemon contre Beelzemon ! Guilmon a pu se digivolver sous une nouvelle forme, en fusionnant avec le cœur pur de Takato. C'est la naissance de Dukemon. Mais alors que Dukemon s'apprête à porter le coup de grâce, une voix retentit.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: On n'est jamais seul
programme.desc: Jen est obnubilé par l'idée de protéger sa petite sœur. Il ne réalise pas que son fidèle Terriermon est de plus en plus faible. Il va falloir agir. Jen parviendra-t-il à puiser dans ses ressources pour trouver une solution et sauver tout le monde ?

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: La grande explication
programme.desc: Ryo et CyberDramon doivent faire face à quatre nouveaux adversaires. Coup de théâtre ! Tout ce temps, les Digi-dompteurs auraient-ils affronté le mauvais ennemi ?! Mais alors, qui est le véritable opposant ?

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Le chaos s'installe
programme.desc: D. Reaper était la véritable ennemie depuis le début. Maintenant que les masques sont tombés, elle passe à l'attaque et s'en prend au Digimonde. Avec ses bulles rouges qui effacent tout ce qu'elles touchent, c'est une adversaire redoutable.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: L'arche de Janyu
programme.desc: Dans le Digimonde, face à D. Reaper, la résistance s'organise grâce à Kurumon. Les Digimon en rangs de bataille ! Pendant ce temps, dans le vrai monde, l'Arche de Janyu est terminée. Il est temps d'embarquer !

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Un triste retour
programme.desc: L'Arche et là ! Takato et ses compagnons vont pouvoir rentrer. Sauf que... Ruki et Renamon manquent à l'appel. Ces deux dernières essaient en effet de sauver Impmon. Alors que l'Arche largue les amarres, le désespoir de Takato la retient !

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Des retrouvailles agitées
programme.desc: Alors que tout le monde est enfin rentré dans le monde réel, les retrouvailles sont gâchées par une troublante nouvelle. D. Reaper serait apparue dans le vrai monde ! En plein Shinjuku ! Takato et ses compagnons décident d'aller l'affronter.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Le grand jour de Beelzemon
programme.desc: Takato et ses compagnons décident de battre en retraite momentanément. Impmon, quant à lui, a enfin retrouvé ses dompteurs adorés, Ai et Makoto. Mais le devoir l'appelle. Quand il aperçoit des images de Shibuya à la télé, le Digimon n'hésite pas.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Le messager
programme.desc: Les parents des Digi-dompteurs font tout pour aider et pour soutenir leurs enfants. Mais la situation est délicate. Dans le monde réel, les enfants ne peuvent pas se fondre avec leur Digimon, ce qui les empêche d'atteindre leur forme ultime.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Une attaque sournoise
programme.desc: Takato a trouvé le moyen de déclencher la digivolution ultime dans le monde réel ! Dukemon est de retour. Mais il est soudain absorbé par D. Reaper, et Takato et Guilmon sont à nouveau séparés. Juri apparaît devant Takato.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Bravo Justimon
programme.desc: Pendant que Justimon, la forme ultime de Ryo et de Cyberdramon, se bat, Dukemon est toujours en danger à l'intérieur de D. Reaper. C'est aussi là que Beelzemon se dirige, maintenant qu'il sait où est Juri. Takato est en danger !

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Une monture de choix
programme.desc: Juri est coincée dans D. Reaper. Takato et ses compagnons font tout pour la sauver. Le père de Juri, qui se sent responsable, se livre à D. Reaper. Dukemon à la rescousse. Pendant ce temps, l'Arche est de retour.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: L'ombre de Leomon
programme.desc: D. Reaper a pris une nouvelle forme pour mieux se protéger. Takato et ses compagnons continuent leurs assauts, dans l'espoir de sauver Juri, prisonnière de D. Reaper. Beelzemon est de la partie aussi, et il est bien décidé à agir.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: La grande frayeur
programme.desc: D. Reaper est la cible de missiles ! Mais alimentée par les émotions toujours plus sombres de Juri, elle continue de grandir, inexorablement. Impmon, lui, a été terriblement blessé. D. Reaper prend la forme d'une statue !

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Jéri se réveille
programme.desc: La carte rouge créée par Mizuno permet à Takato et à ses compagnons d'utiliser leurs formes ultimes à l'intérieur de D. Reaper ! Juri, quant à elle, est enfin touchée par les mots de Leomon et se décide à se battre.

programme.title: Digimon Tamers: Un si doux chagrin
programme.desc: Dukemon tient tête à D. Reaper ! Justimon hérite du restant de forces de Sakuyamon, et ensemble, les Digi-dompteurs parviennent à vaincre D. Reaper. Une fois la poussière du combat retombée, Impmon s'avance vers Juri, la tête basse.

programme.title: Digimon Adventure: L’arrivée de Flamedramon
programme.desc: Trois ans après les précédentes aventures, le Digimonde est à nouveau en danger ! Lorsqu'il s'agit de sauver Agumon, Taichi n'hésite pas un seul instant. Trois nouveaux Digi-sauveurs font leur apparition et deux anciens reprennent du service.

programme.title: Digimon Adventure: La Nouvelle Équipe
programme.desc: Daisuke et ses compagnons retournent dans le Digimonde. Iori et Miyako se joignent à l'aventure et découvrent ce nouveau monde avec des étoiles dans les yeux. Mais soudain, c'est la catastrophe : l'Empereur des Digimon attaque !

programme.title: Digimon Adventure: Nouvelles données
programme.desc: Patamon et Gatomon sont coincés ! Ils sont attaqués par le féroce Tyranomon et ils ne peuvent pas se défendre. Takeru et Hikaru sont découragés par leur faiblesse. Mais il ne faut pas perdre espoir, rien n'est perdu pour ces valeureux guerriers !

programme.title: Digimon Adventure: Un digimon agressif
programme.desc: Gabumon est attaqué par une étrange et sournoise puissance. Il appelle Yamato au secours ! L'Empereur des Digimon masse ses forces. À l'ombre des Tours noires, nombreux sont les Digimon qui rejoignent ses rangs.

programme.title: Digimon Adventure: Une valeur sûre
programme.desc: Gomamon est capturé par l'Empereur des Digimon ! Jô est prêt à retourner dans le Digimonde pour sauver son compagnon. Les Yukidarumon attaquent. De son côté, Gomamon réussira-t-il à se digivolver pour venir à bout de la Tour noire ?

programme.title: Digimon Adventure: Un beau pique-nique
programme.desc: C'est au tour de Mimi de faire escale dans le Digimonde, le temps d'un pique-nique entre Digi-sauveurs. Même Palmon est de la partie ! Mais soudain, un trou béant s'ouvre et le repas champêtre vire à la catastrophe. Les frères Gokimon attaquent !

programme.title: Digimon Adventure: L’ange gardien
programme.desc: Après avoir détruit une Tour noire, Hikari est en danger dans le monde digital ! N’écoutant que leur courage, Daisuke et Takeru s'élancent à son aide. Ils vont devoir affronter de redoutables ennemis, manipulés par l'Empereur des Digimon en personne.

programme.title: Digimon Adventure: Le secret de Ken
programme.desc: Dans le vrai monde, sur un terrain de foot, Daisuke affronte un jeune prodige nommé Ken Ichijôji. Au cours d'un match, Daisuke blesse Ken à la jambe. Plus tard, dans le Digimonde, Daisuke s'aperçoit que l'Empereur porte exactement la même blessure.

programme.title: Digimon Adventure: L’empereur s’installe
programme.desc: Ken décide de s'enfuir de chez lui pour s'en aller vers le Digimonde. Il kidnappe Agumon et se sert de lui pour déclencher une évolution obscure. SkullGreymon est de retour et il est incontrôlable. Greymon parviendra-t-il à s'arrêter à temps ?

programme.title: Digimon Adventure: Le digimon prisonnier
programme.desc: Greymon a bien du mal à se remettre des petites expériences de l'Empereur des Digimon. La piste SkullGreymon ne lui ayant pas donné satisfaction, ce dernier consacre ses efforts à un nouvel objectif : la Spirale infernale.

programme.title: Digimon Adventure: Une solide amitié
programme.desc: MetalGreymon est passé sous le contrôle de l'infâme Empereur des Digimon. Daisuke ne sait pas quoi faire, il ne peut se résoudre à affronter Agumon, son ami... Heureusement, l'activation d'un Digi-œuf va venir tout changer.

programme.desc: Bentornati in un nuovo episodio di Bolognese DNA! Oggi, insieme a Jacopo Falsini e ai nostri amici francesi Gérard e Sebastién, proveremo a catturare alcuni degli astuti e diffidenti cavedani che popolano le acque del Casentino. A guidarci sarà Adriano Sestini, pescatore della zona e grande esperto di questi ciprinidi. Si dice che li conosca addirittura per nome… e dopo averlo visto pescare, non è difficile crederlo! La pesca al cavedano richiede terminali estremamente sottili, presentazioni naturali e un'attrezzatura capace di proteggere i fili più delicati. Allo stesso tempo, la canna deve possedere la giusta riserva di potenza per assorbire le violente testate e contrastare le improvvise ripartenze del pesce. Per affrontare questa pescata è stata quindi scelta la gamma FIUME WR T da 16 g: FIUME WR T-8000 FIUME WR T-8001 FIUME WR T-6000. Tre canne progettate per unire sensibilità, controllo e potenza, qualità fondamentali quando si affrontano pesci tanto sospettosi quanto combattivi. Mettetevi comodi e preparatevi a vivere una nuova giornata di tecnica, amicizia e pesca nel cuore del Casentino.

programme.desc: Après avoir laissé Shelley chez les Cartman, la famille Marsh se rend chez M. Mackey, et Stan est relégué à la cave avec d'autres enfants pas très fréquentables. Pendant ce temps, les papas de South Park expérimentent le jacuzzi.

programme.title: South Park: Les Scouts juifs
programme.desc: Pendant que leurs parents sont à la fêtes, Kyle, Ike et Kenny sont à une fête religieuse juif. Ils se rendent compte rapidement que cette cérémonie sera propice à un complot.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpokomon
programme.desc: Les enfants sont pris dans la folie Chinpokomon qui est en fait une conspiration anti-americaine de nostalgiques de Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: South Park: Ethernopien dans l'Espace
programme.desc: Pascal la Dalle cherche où reloger son village pour qu'ils échappent aux missionnaires chrétiens.

programme.title: South Park: HumancentiPad
programme.desc: Kyle ist unmittelbar an der Entwicklung eines revolutionären Produkts namens 'HumancentiPad' beteiligt, das Apple neu auf den Markt bringen will.

programme.title: South Park: Pudding Royal
programme.desc: Die königliche Hochzeit Kanadas steht bevor. Ein großer Tag für Kanada & für die Welt. Bevor es jedoch zum Ja-Wort kommt, wird die Prinzessin Kanadas entführt. Ein landesweiter Aufruf lässt die Kanadier zusammenkommen und nach der Prinzessin suchen.

programme.title: South Park: Und Noch Immer Ist Cartmans Mama Eine Schlampe!
programme.sub-title: Und Noch Immer Ist Cartmans Mama Eine Schlampe!
programme.desc: Die Wahrheit über Cartmans Mama soll in dieser Folge ans Licht gebracht werden. Nur leider wird Mephisto angeschossen und die Jungs müssen ihn ins Krankenhaus bringen. Am Ende erfährt man aber doch noch schockierende Details über Cartmans Mom.

programme.title: South Park: Jetzt Gibt's Was auf die Ohren
programme.sub-title: Jetzt Gibt's Was auf die Ohren
programme.desc: Mr. Garrison versucht verzweifelt das Blaskonzert der dritten Klassenstufe in Arkansas abzusagen, um dort ein Wiedersehen mit seiner entfremdeten Familie zu vermeiden. Erst Mr. Mackey bringt ihn dazu, sich seinen Problemen zu stellen.

programme.title: South Park: Helen Keller: das Musical
programme.desc: Wie jedes Jahr soll die 4. Klasse der Grundschule South Park an Thanksgiving die Geschichte der tauben und blinden Helen Keller auf die Bühne bringen. Cartman will unbedingt, dass es diesmal etwas ganz besonderes wird.

programme.title: South Park: Urlaub mit Kenny & Butters
programme.desc: Butters rastet aus: es stellt sich heraus, dass seine Eltern Hawaiianer sind. Ihrer alten Tradition entsprechend, schicken sie den Jungen nach Hawaii, um seine Wut durch die Hapa Noa-Zeremonie zu zähmen.

programme.title: South Park: Ein Alptraum an Halloween
programme.desc: Randy Marsh glaubt, dass man mit einer Blockbuster-Videothek noch Geld verdienen kann. Er will nicht wahrhaben, dass die Menschen heutzutage die Filme ihrer Wahl online genießen. Doch als die Kundschaft gänzlich ausbleibt, wird er paranoid.

programme.title: South Park: Ein Toller Applaus
programme.desc: Enttäuscht lassen sich die Southparker ihre 'Was würde Jesus tun'-Armbänder entfernen, da ein Forscherteam entdeckt hat, dass Jesus nur deshalb wiederauferstehen konnte, weil er leistungssteigernde Hormone genommen hatte. Nur Stan bleibt Jesus treu.

programme.title: South Park: Wählt Obama!
programme.desc: Obama wird wieder zum Präsidenten gewählt. Doch ist dieses Wahlergebnis zweifelhaft, denn Cartman klaut die Wählerstimmen der Swing States. Die Chinesen geben ihm dafür den Auftrag, dafür verlangen sie jedoch die Rechte an den Starwars-Filmen.

programme.title: South Park: Lass los, die NSA liebt dich
programme.sub-title: Lass los, die NSA liebt dich
programme.desc: Als Cartman die NSA infiltriert, gefällt ihm gar nicht, was er in seiner eigenen Akte zu lesen bekommt. Verkleidet als Bill Clinton schleust er sich selbst bei der NSA ein.

programme.title: South Park: Infotainment-Mörderpornos
programme.desc: In South Park gehen die sogenannten Mörderpornos um. Die verschiedenen Sendungen, in denen Morde unter Eheleuten vor, während oder nach dem Sex nachgestellt werden, wirken auch auf Stans Eltern anregend.

programme.title: South Park: World War Zimmerman
programme.desc: Cartman wird von Albträumen geplagt. In der Rolle des Brad Pitt in dem Film 'World War Z' ist er unterwegs, um eine Epidemie zu bekämpfen. Doch sind es in diesem Fall nicht die Zombies, sondern die Schwarzen, die im ganzen Land Unruhe stiften.

programme.title: South Park: Goth Kids 3
programme.desc: Henriettas Eltern kommen nur schwer damit klar, dass ihre Tochter mit den Goth-Kids rumhängt. Nach einer Beratung wird entschieden, die Tochter in ein Camp zu schicken.

programme.title: South Park: Die Zähmung des widerspenstigen Spaltes
programme.desc: Als Ike in die Pubertät kommt, gibt es zunehmend Streit zwischen ihm und Kyle. Um die angeknackste Beziehung zu kitten, nimmt Kyle ihn mit zu einer Live-Performance von 'Yo Gabba Gabba'.

programme.title: South Park: Die Red Robin Hochzeit
programme.desc: Die Jungs bereiten sich auf einen Kampf gegen die Menschenmenge vor, die bereits Schlange steht, um am ersten offiziellen Tag des Weihnachtsgeschäftes als Erstes in das Einkaufszentrum zu gelangen.

programme.title: South Park: Das Lied von Arsch und Feuer
programme.sub-title: Das Lied von Arsch und Feuer
programme.desc: Der Black Friday steht vor der Tür, und der Kampf um die neuen Spielkonsolen heizt sich weiter an. Nach Prinzessin Kennys Verrat schwört Cartman Rache.

programme.title: South Park: Der Hobbit
programme.desc: Wendy versucht zu beweisen, wie sehr junge Mädchen unter dem Druck des Schönheitsideals, welches zahlreiche berühmte Persönlichkeiten zur Schau stellen, leiden müssen. Ihre Kampagne brockt ihr dabei eine ganze Menge Ärger ein.

programme.title: South Park: Leckt Euch Selbst
programme.desc: Die Jungs geben ihrem neuen Start-up den Namen 'The Washington Redskins'.

programme.title: South Park: Glutenfreies Ebola
programme.desc: Die Einwohner von South Park verzichten auf Gluten.

programme.title: South Park: Die Cissy
programme.desc: Laut Eric Cartman ist Wendy Testaburger jetzt lesbisch.

programme.title: South Park: Handicar
programme.desc: Timmys erfolgreicher neuer Fahrdienst bringt ihm jede Menge Feinde ein.

programme.title: South Park: Freemium gibt's nicht umsonst
programme.desc: Stan ist süchtig nach dem neuen Handyspiel von Terrance und Phillip.

programme.title: South Park: Die Hausarrest-Schleife
programme.desc: Butters ist davon überzeugt, in einer virtuellen Welt festzusitzen.

programme.title: South Park: Hashtag 'Aufwärmen'
programme.desc: Kyle will mit seinem kleinen Bruder Ike Videospiele spielen. Als der nicht mehr mit ihm spielen will, hat Kyle Angst, dass er die Kids von heute nicht mehr versteht.

programme.title: South Park: Fröhliche Hologramme
programme.desc: CartmanBra ist total angesagt und Amerika bereitet sich auf das größte TV-Weihnachtsspecial aller Zeiten vor.

programme.title: South Park: Die mieseste Gegend der Stadt
programme.desc: Die Gentrifizierung ist in South Park angekommen und Kenny sucht sich einen Job.

programme.title: South Park: Sag Ja zu Yelp
programme.desc: Cartman hält sich für den wichtigsten Restaurantkritik-Blogger in South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Ein sicherer Raum
programme.desc: Cartman wird Opfer von Bodyshaming.

programme.title: South Park: Tweek und Craig
programme.desc: Die asiatischen Schülerinnen malen romantische Bilder von Tweek und Craig.

programme.title: South Park: Werbung und Wahrheit
programme.desc: PC Principal und zwei Viertklässler verschwinden.

programme.title: South Park: Weißt-du-noch-Beeren
programme.desc: In der ersten Folge von Staffel 20 wird die Nationalhymne von einem amerikanischen Idol neu aufgelegt.

programme.title: South Park: Skankhunt
programme.desc: Kyles Vater schafft es, seine Identität als Troll geheim zu halten, und weitet seine Online-Schikane auf die ganze Welt aus.

programme.title: South Park: Die Verdammten
programme.desc: Gerald freut sich über die Aufmerksamkeit, die die Medien seinen Hassbotschaften im Internet schenken, und mobbt fleißig weiter.

programme.title: South Park: Der Einlauf und Dänische Delikatessen
programme.desc: Der Riesen-Einlauf will aus dem Präsidentschaftswahlkampf aussteigen.

programme.title: South Park: Herrgott!
programme.desc: Gerald trifft den Troll-Jäger.

programme.title: South Park: Nur für Mitglieder
programme.desc: Der designierte Präsident besucht seine Heimatstadt.

programme.title: South Park: Nicht Witzig
programme.desc: Cartman glaubt, dass Butters ihm seine Freundin ausspannen will.

programme.title: South Park: Das Ende der Serialisierung Wie Wir Sie Kennen
programme.sub-title: Das Ende der Serialisierung Wie Wir Sie Kennen
programme.desc: Cartman versteht endlich, warum Heidi mit ihm zum Mars will.

programme.desc: Rodada en una de las prisiones mas peligrosas de Guatemala, VIP cuenta la historia de Juan Ramos, Sub – Contralor General de la Nación, quien es arrestado e ingresado a prisión preventiva, mientras prueba su inocencia por cargos de corrupción y asesinato. Aunque ha pagado por estar en el sector VIP, es llevado al peor sector de la cárcel. Su lucha por llegar a ser parte del sector exclusivo, lo hará conocer la cruda realidad vivida día a día dentro de la prisión. Pero desde el VIP, sus enemigos cocinan planes vengativos con el fin de hacer la estadía de Juan lo mas corta y violenta posible.

programme.title: Muerto por Carol
programme.desc: Carol se muda con su padre y abuelo al tranquilo pueblo de Zapote, donde experimenta la intensidad del primer amor junto a Rito. Entre descubrimientos, emociones y el despertar de nuevos sentimientos, su vida cambia para siempre en esta historia íntima y entrañable.

programme.title: Los héroes de las Ardenas
programme.desc: La historia real de la heroica experiencia de Don Smith en la Batalla de las Ardenas, cuando formaba parte del 94º de Infantería.

programme.title: L'ingorgo
programme.desc: Un corteo di macchine procede sempre più lentamente lungo la tangenziale di Roma, sino a che ogni possibilità di movimento si blocca. L`ingorgo durerà 36 ore. Sin dai primi momenti il nervosismo dei viaggiatori è evidente. Quando sfumano le speranze di una veloce soluzione, mancano notizie, si palesano le prime necessità, la tensione sale al massimo e non pochi trascendono. La circostanza permette di scoprire i lati peggiori dell`umanità presente...

programme.title: La grande abbuffata
programme.desc: In una villa fuori Parigi quattro vecchi amici si riuniscono per un week-end abbandonandosi ad un`orgia di cibo e sesso. Uno di loro, Marcello, porta con sé alcune prostitute che disgustate dall`ambiente se ne andranno. Ad un certo punto una maestra va lì per caso con in suoi alunni in visita al giardino della villa, rimane affascinata dai quattro e decide di fare ritorno unendosi a loro nel folle e autodistruttivo fine settimana...

programme.title: Una giornata particolare
programme.desc: 6 maggio 1938. La Roma fascista è in festa per l`arrivo del Fuhrer in visita dal Duce. In un angolo di Roma più lontano dai fasti, in un edificio popolare, Antonietta, casalinga madre di sei figli, cresciuta nel culto del Duce, incontra casualmente per la prima volta il suo vicino di casa, Gabriele, ex annunciatore radiofonico omosessuale e prossimo al confino. Dopo la diffidenza iniziale, il loro rapporto si trasforma in affetto e comprensione...

programme.title: La decima vittima
programme.desc: In un futuro dove le guerre sono state abolite, per dare sfogo all`aggressività dell`individuo viene legalizzata la caccia all`uomo. Una volta entrati a far parte di un club internazionale e accettate le regole, ogni membro può essere sia cacciatore che preda. Dopo dieci battute di caccia portate a termine vengono concessi onori trionfali: Caroline, alla sua nona esperienza, parte per Roma, dove vive Marcello, la sua ultima preda...

programme.title: La casa del custode

Per puro caso arriva a Brent, in Alabama. Qui viene accolto da Nina, madre single e cantante di un coro gospel. Grazie al potere della musica, Jacob comincerà a guardare nuovamente al futuro.

programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Paradise
programme.desc: Sisko and O'Brien are stranded on a planet inhabited by humans who have rejected any form of technology.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Shadowplay
programme.desc: Odo and Dax try to solve the mystery of an alien planet whose inhabitants are disappearing without explanation.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Playing God
programme.desc: While hosting her first Trill initiate, Dax discovers a tiny, developing universe, which threatens to destroy the station as it expands.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Profit And Loss
programme.desc: When Quark is reunited with the love of his life, a Cardassian who is now a fugitive, he is ready to sacrifice everything to win her back.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Blood Oath
programme.desc: Dax risks her life and her future with Starfleet to fulfill a blood oath made with three aged Klingons.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Maquis, Part 1
programme.desc: Sisko uncovers a Federation terrorist group whose actions could start another war with the Cardassians.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Maquis, Part 2
programme.desc: Sisko and Gul Dukat join forces in an effort to avert a war between the Cardassians and a group of Federation colonists led by Sisko's old friend.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Wire
programme.desc: Bashir fights to save his Cardassian friend Garak, who is slowly being killed by a brain implant to which he is addicted.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Crossover
programme.desc: A mishap in the wormhole sends Kira and Bashir into an alternate universe where Bajor is a tyrannical power and humans are slaves.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Collaborator
programme.desc: Kira must investigate the man she loves when she learns he may be the Cardassian collaborator responsible for the massacre of forty-three Bajorans.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Tribunal
programme.desc: O'Brien is arrested by the Cardassians and put on trial for a crime he insists he did not commit.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: The Jem'hadar
programme.desc: During a trip to the Gamma Quadrant with Jake and Nog, Sisko and Quark are imprisoned by soldiers working for a mysterious power known as the Dominion.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Letingen, del I
programme.desc: Hoping to avert an invasion, Sisko takes his officers into the Gamma Quadrant to find the leaders of the Dominion

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Letingen, del II
programme.desc: While Odo struggles to learn the ways of his people, Sisko discovers that the price of peace with the Dominion may be too high.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Quarks hus
programme.desc: In order to boost his business and gain respect, Quark lies about killing a Klingon, then winds up forced to marry the dead man's widow.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Ekvilibrium
programme.desc: A deadly secret from Dax's past could mean the end of Jadzia's life.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Andre skinn
programme.desc: Kira is kidnapped by the Cardassians, who try to convince her that she is really one of their people.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Den forlatte
programme.desc: Odo tries to convince a young,violent Jem'Hadar that there is more to life than fighting and killing.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Sivilt forsvar
programme.desc: A trapped crew fights to save the station from self-destruction when an automated Cardassian security program is accidentally activated.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Meridian
programme.desc: Dax falls in love with a man who will soon disappear with his planet into another dimension for sixty years.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Aaron, Carol, Lydia e Jerry vão para as ruínas de Hilltop em busca de ferramentas de ferreiro; o grupo de Eugene passa por orientação na Commonwealth; Maggie e Negan caminham pela floresta; Judith e as crianças brigam com adolescentes. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Connie y Virgil se esconden en una casa ocupada por misteriosas criaturas, en su afán de escaparse de los caminantes. Pope pone a prueba la lealtad de Daryl hacia los Reapers con una misión controvertida. Kelly deja Alexandria para buscar a Connie.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Maggie e Elijah aprendem uma nova tática de sobrevivência com Negan; o grupo de Eugene elimina os zumbis; Yumiko se prepara para uma entrevista de emprego de alta classe; Daryl aprende mais sobre Leah e os Reapers. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Os Reapers defendem Meridian de uma horda; Pope suspeita que Maggie esteja por trás do ataque, enquanto Daryl segue com cautela; o povo de Alexandria luta por proteção quando uma tempestade os deixa vulneráveis aos zumbis. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Daryl, Maggie, Gabriel, Negan e Elijah lutam contra os Reapers por comida; Aaron e os alexandrinos devem sobreviver a uma tempestade. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: El grupo celebra Halloween en el interior de la Mancomunidad. Daryl y Rosita se someten a un entrenamiento militar dirigido por Mercer, mientras Carol investiga el problema de salud de Ezekiel.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Eugene procura Stephanie depois que ela desaparece misteriosamente; Connie investiga uma história sobre Trooper Davis; Carol ajuda Hornsby com uma disputa trabalhista em uma fazenda de drogas. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Aaron e Maggie conhecem a governadora Pamela Milton enquanto ela visita Alexandria, Oceanside e Hilltop; Ezequiel encontra a sorte durante um check-up de rotina; Eugene processa a história de Max. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Maggie, Lydia e Elijah ajudam um estranho de outra comunidade chamada Riverbend; eles encontram Aaron, que lhes conta sobre uma missão em que ele embarcou com Gabriel, como emissários da Commonwealth. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Maggie, Lydia e Elijah ajudam Aaron e Gabriel em uma missão de resgate; em meio ao caos, Negan se vê cuidando de Hershel; em outro lugar, Sebastian coage Daryl e Rosita a fazer um assalto. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Hornsby marcha com Daryl para enfrentar Maggie em Hilltop; depois de um assalto, Rosita consegue que Connie, Kelly, Eugene e Max investiguem os Miltons; após a cirurgia, Ezekiel usa sua nova vida para ajudar os pacientes do hospital em necessidade. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Maggie se prepara para defender Hilltop y a los habitantes de Riverbend frente al ataque de Hornsby. Mientras tanto, este contrata a Leah para que la mate.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Daryl e Negan correm para a Commonwealth para impedir que Hornsby vá atrás de suas famílias; Pamela lida com manifestantes exigindo justiça pelos crimes de Sebastian; Mercer precisa da ajuda de Rosita para combater um enxame. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Carol y Pamela hacen un trato de borrón y cuenta nueva en nombre de sus amigos. Aaron, Jerry, Lydia y Elijah se marchan hacia Oceanside para hablarles de un plan. La Commonwealth celebra el Día de los Fundadores.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Eugene huye después del incidente del Día de los Fundadores. Pamela le pide a Mercer que investigue dónde está, para disgusto de Max y La Princesa. Por otro lado, Aaron, Jerry, Lydia y Elijah se topan con un contratiempo peculiar.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: Daryl y Carol investigan el paradero de sus amigos después de que Pamela los hiciera desaparecer de la Commonwealth. Por desgracia, su única pista es Hornsby. Por otro lado, Pamela le pide a Yumiko que procese a Eugene en nombre de la Commonwealth.

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Depois de se separarem de seus filhos, Maggie, Gabriel e Rosita seguem um trem militar para um destino misterioso; Ezekiel, Kelly, Negan e Annie acabam em uma zona de construção; Daryl e Carol seguem um trem que leva Connie a bordo. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Ezekiel e Negan organizam uma revolta clandestina contra os Guardiões; Aaron, Jerry, Lydia e Elijah se unem a Luke e Jules durante sua fuga para a costa; Eugene é levado a julgamento com o apoio de Yumiko como advogada de defesa. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Os alexandrinos e os prisioneiros retornam à Commonwealth para enfrentar Pamela Milton; uma horda se aproxima da cidade. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Daryl e Carol correm para o hospital com Judith; Rosita, Eugene e Gabriel procuram Coco; Maggie e Negan se armam contra Pamela; os cidadãos de Commonwealth enfrentam a horda e os heróis se unem para proteger seu futuro. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Rick procura sua família quando acorda de seu estado de coma; Morgan e Duane ajudam a ensinar Rick as novas regras de sobrevivência. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Rick acidentalmente deixa um grupo de sobreviventes cercado de mortos-vivos. Ele precisa enfrentar um inimigo ainda mais perigoso do que os mortos-vivos. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Rick decide retornar a Atlanta para salvar a vida de um homem; Lori e Shane lidam com a surpresa do retorno de alguém que eles pensavam estar morto. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. A missão de Rick para Atlanta está comprometida; Jim se descontrola no acampamento. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: The Walking Dead
programme.desc: 1970. Jim deve tomar uma terrível decisão de vida ou morte; Rick lidera o grupo até o CDC após o ataque. Gêneros: Entertainment

programme.title: Oscar De La Hoya vs Rafael Ruelas
programme.desc: On May 6th, 1995 Oscar De La Hoya fought Rafael Ruelas for IBF and WBO World Lightweight titles at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas. The 12 round bout only went two rounds ending in technical knockout favoring De La Hoya.

programme.title: Oscar Valdez vs Miguel Berchelt
programme.desc: On February 20th, 2021 Oscar Valdez and Miguel Berchelt faced eachother for the WBC World Super Featherweight title during "The Bubble" at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas with Berchelt going down three times Valdez scared the win in the 10th round.

programme.title: Oscar Valdez vs Scott Quigg
programme.desc: On March 10th, 2018, Oscar Valdez and Scott Quigg fought for the WBO World Featherweight Championship in Carson, CA. Oscar Valdez defeated Scott Quigg by unanimous decision in a thrilling fight, showcasing his superior skills and resilience.

programme.title: Paulie Ayala vs Johnny Tapia 1
programme.desc: On June 26th, 1999, Paulie Ayala fought Johnny Tapia for the WBA Bantamweight Title at the Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas. In what was the 1999 Ring Magazine Fight of the Year, the two men put on a show that ended with an Ayala unanimous decision victory.

programme.title: Randall Bailey vs Mike Jones
programme.desc: On June 9th, 2012 Randall Bailey and Mike Jones fought for vacant IBF World welterweight titles at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas that ended in the 11th round by knockout resulting in a victory for Bailey.

programme.title: Ray Mancini vs Arturo Frias
programme.desc: On May 8th, 1982 Ray Mancini and Arturo Frias fought for the WBA World Lightweight title at the Aladdin in Las Vegas with what was supposed to be a 15 round bout ending in the first by technical knockout securing the victory for Ray Mancini.

programme.title: Ray Mancini vs Orlando Romero
programme.desc: On September 15th, 1983 Ray Mancini fought Orlando Romero for the WBA World Lightweight title at Madison Square Garden in New York with the bout ending in the ninth round by knockout earning Mancini the win.

programme.title: Ray Mercer vs Bert Cooper
programme.desc: On August 5th, 1990 Ray Mercer faced Bert Cooper for Heavyweight titles at the Convention Hall in Atlantic City with the bout ending by unanimous decision in favor of Mercer.

programme.title: Ray Mercer vs Tommy Morrison
programme.desc: On October 18th, 1991 Ray Mercer faced Tommy Morrison for the WBO World Heavyweight titles at the Convention Center in Atlantic City ending in technical knockout by Mercer earning him the victory and title but, he relinquished the title shortly after.

programme.title: Rob Brant vs Ryota Murata 1
programme.desc: On October 20th, 2018 Rob Brant faced Ryota Murata for a second time for the WBA World Middleweight title at the Park Theater in Las Vegas that ended in a unanimous decision victory for Brant.

programme.title: Robeisy Ramirez vs Abraham Nova
programme.desc: On June 18th, 2022, Robeisy Ramirez and Abraham Nova fought for the IBF USBA & WBO Global Featherweight titles at Madison Square Garden resulting in a knockout victory for Robeisy Ramirez.

programme.title: Robeisy Ramirez vs Brandon Valdes
programme.desc: On December 12th, 2020, Robeisy Ramirez fought Brandon Valdes in a featherweight bout in The Bubble at MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Ramirez showed his impressive speed and natural power, stopping Valdes in the sixth round.

programme.title: Roberto Duran vs Davey Moore
programme.desc: On June 16th, 1983 Roberto Duran fought Davey Moore for the WBA World Super welterweight title at Madison Square Garden in New York Moore was knocked down in the 7th round giving the win to Duran.

programme.title: Roberto Duran vs Iran Barkley
programme.desc: On February 24th, 1989, Roberto Duran fought Iran Barkley for the WBC Middleweight Title in Atlantic City. Duran, known for his relentless aggression, defeated Barkley by a close split decision in what was named The Ring Fight of the Year for 1989.

programme.title: Roberto Duran vs Jimmy Batten
programme.desc: On November 12th, 1982 Roberto Duran faced Jimmy Batten at the Orange Bowl in Miami, Fl. It ended in an unanimous decision victory for Duran.

programme.title: Roberto Duran vs Sugar Ray Leonard 1
programme.desc: On December 7th, 1989 Roberto Duran and Sugar Ray Leonard fought for the first time for the WBC World Super Middleweight at the Mirage Hotel in Las Vegas resulting in a unanimous decision win for Leonard.

programme.title: Roman Gonzalez vs. Juan Francisco Estrada 1
programme.desc: On November 17th, 2012, Roman Gonzalez fought Juan Francisco Estrada for the WBA World Light Flyweight Title at the Sports Arena in Los Angeles. In a successful title defense fight, Gonzalez earned the unanimous decision victory.

programme.title: Roy Jones Jr vs James Toney
programme.desc: On November 18th, 1994, Roy Jones Jr fought James Toney for the IBF Super Middleweight Title at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Jones displayed his exceptional athleticism and speed, outclassing Toney to win a unanimous decision victory.

programme.title: The People Under the Stairs
programme.desc: Hoping to find a fortune in gold, a boy instead discovers the horrific secrets lurking inside the home of two murderous siblings.","large":"When young Fool (Brandon Adams) breaks into the home of his family's greedy and uncaring landlords, he discovers a disturbing scenario where incestuous adult siblings have mutilated a number of boys and kept them imprisoned under stairs in their large, creepy house. As Fool attempts to flee before the psychopaths can catch him, he meets their daughter, Alice (A.J. Langer), who has been spared any extreme discipline by her deranged parents. Can Fool and Alice escape before it's too late?

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: An acid-scarred composer (Claude Rains) rises from the Paris sewers to boost his favorite opera understudy's (Susanna Foster) career.","large":"Talented Christine (Susanna Foster) is unaware that her singing lessons are being funded by a secret admirer, Enrique (Claude Rains), a mysterious violinist with a disfigured face. Christine's colleagues become suspicious when mysterious accidents start occurring at the Paris Opera House, as the deaths coincide with her meteoric rise to stardom. Christine's suitors, Raoul (Edgar Barrier) and Anatole (Nelson Eddy), brave the dark recesses of the opera house to find the true culprit.

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera
programme.desc: An acid-scarred composer (Herbert Lom) has his dwarf helper bring an opera singer (Heather Sears) to his London sewer hide-out.","large":"Composer Lord Ambrose D'Arcy (Michael Gough) and his backer, Harry Hunter (Edward De Souza), struggle to find a replacement for the female lead in their new opera after she quits in the wake of a gruesome murder. When a new prospect, the nubile Christine Charles (Heather Sears), disappears, Harry cautiously investigates. Meanwhile, a mysterious masked man (Herbert Lom) who is eerily familiar with the opera holds Christine captive and offers to groom her to play the part.

programme.title: Son of Frankenstein
programme.desc: The baron's son (Basil Rathbone) revives his father's monster (Boris Karloff) with help from a broken-necked shepherd called Ygor (Bela Lugosi).","large":"Baron Wolf von Frankenstein is determined to prove the legitimacy of his father's scientific work, thus rescuing the family name from disgrace. With the help of Ygor, a grave robber, Wolf successfully reanimates the monster his father originally brought back from the dead. But when several villagers are killed mysteriously, Wolf must find the culprit in order to vindicate his creation, or face the possibility that he may be responsible.

programme.title: Sssssss
programme.desc: A snake scientist (Strother Martin) turns his daughter's (Heather Menzies) boyfriend (Dirk Benedict), his lab helper, into a big cobra.","large":"Short on cash, undergrad David Blake (Dirk Benedict) takes a job working as a lab assistant for snake expert Dr. Carl Stoner (Strother Martin). When Stoner begins giving David a series of antibiotics as a safeguard against snakebites, he at first thinks nothing of it. But gradually David begins to notice curious changes in his body, and his new girlfriend, Dr. Stoner's daughter, Kristina (Heather Menzies), notices them too. Could Dr. Stoner really be trying to turn his assistant into a snake?

programme.desc: An alien that can duplicate other life forms invades a polar research station in this remake of the 1951 classic "The Thing from Another World."","large":"In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.","large":"Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: The Mexican government hires two handymen (Fred Ward, Michael Gross) to battle huge man-eating worms plaguing an oil field.","large":"After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: The Werewolf of London
programme.desc: An Asian werewolf (Warner Oland) bites a botanist (Henry Hull) in Tibet and rivals him for the antidote in London.","large":"While in Tibet researching a mysterious flower that purportedly takes its strength from the moon, botanist Wilfred Glendon is bitten by a strange creature. Back in London, Glendon becomes absorbed in his research of the plant, and is annoyed by the appearance of fellow scientist Dr. Yogami, who reveals that the plant is the only known temporary antidote for werewolves. Glendon remains skeptical until the next full moon, when he undergoes a startling transformation.

programme.title: The Wolf Man
programme.desc: Bitten by a werewolf, an aristocrat (Lon Chaney) grows fangs, fur and a muzzle, then begs his father (Claude Rains) for help.","large":"When his brother dies, Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney) returns to Wales and reconciles with his father (Claude Rains). While there, he visits an antique shop and, hoping to impress Gwen (Evelyn Ankers), the attractive shopkeeper, buys a silver walking cane. That same night he kills a wolf with it, only to later learn that he actually killed a man (Bela Lugosi). A gypsy (Maria Ouspenskaya) explains that it was her son, a werewolf, that he killed, and that Larry is now one himself.

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Fifteen years after they were abducted by aliens, four men get a chance to take revenge when they capture one of the creatures.","large":"Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: Habiter le monde: Kyoto: éloge de la nature
programme.desc: En arrivant à Kyoto, les quelques 2 000 temples et sanctuaires disséminés dans la ville font prendre conscience à Philippe à quel point le sacré imprègne la ville.

programme.title: Chacun son Île

programme.title: Horizons
programme.desc: Horizons infinis. Miracles de la nature. Vénérables cathédrales. Monastères mystiques. Montagnes sacrées. Énigmes préhistoriques. Ce sont quelques caractéristiques de l’Arménie ; un mélange bouillonnant d’art, de dévotion.

programme.title: Horizons
programme.desc: Le Portugal a longtemps suscité les convoitises. Pays d’invasions et de conquêtes, il fut jadis le point de départ des plus grands explorateurs du globe. Il offre au visiteur le remarquable patrimoine culturel.

programme.title: Habiter le monde: Vietnam: les maisons-tubes d'Hanoï

programme.title: Habiter le monde: Louisiane: Bayous, un paradis

programme.title: Extreme Cities FR: Bangkok

programme.title: Extreme Cities FR: Hammerfest
programme.desc: Novembre au sommet du fjord que surplombe Hammerfest, la ville la plus au nord du monde. A midi, le soleil se couche pour la dernière fois. Il ne se lèvera plus avant la fin janvier.

programme.title: Horizons
programme.desc: Du Sud au Nord, le Vietnam s’étire comme un dragon tout au long de la mer de Chine. Berceau d’une civilisation d’une grande richesse, le Vietnam est un écrin aux multiples facettes qui offre un cadre naturel somptueux.

programme.title: Horizons

programme.title: Dynasty: Colpo di scena
programme.desc: Durante il processo a Blake, molti segreti vengono svelati. Claudia, ad esempio, deve affermare in tribunale che tra lei e Steven c'era del tenero. Il fatto fa infuriare Matthew che aggredisce Blake.

programme.title: Dynasty: Arriva Alexis
programme.desc: La misteriosa donna chiamata dal procuratore distrettuale Jake Dunham durante il processo contro Blake è Alexis Morell Carrington, prima moglie di Blake e madre di Steven e Fallon.

programme.title: Dynasty: Conflitti insuperabili
programme.desc: Blake viene condannato a due anni di carcere incondizionato. Intanto, Alexis si stabilisce in una vecchia dépendance di Villa Carrington di sua proprietà.

programme.title: Dynasty: Tentativo di suicidio
programme.desc: Claudia viene dimessa dall'ospedale. Giunta a casa, assume delle pillole con l'intenzione di suicidarsi, ma viene salvata in extremis da un amico di Blake, il dottor Nick Toscanni.

programme.title: Dynasty: Vite in gioco
programme.desc: Alexis dice a Blake che Fallon non è sua figlia e usa questa informazione per ricattare l'uomo. Krystle intanto trova sempre più irritante la presenza di Alexis nei pressi di Villa Carrington.

programme.title: Dynasty: Una nipotina ribelle
programme.desc: L'incidente quasi mortale di Steven riavvicina il ragazzo a suo padre. Alexis approfitta della degenza di suo figlio per poter entrare e uscire da casa Carrington a suo piacimento.

programme.title: Dynasty: Sete di vendetta
programme.desc: Blake vola a Las Vegas per ottenere un prestito di 9 milioni di dollari da un gangster. Alexis scorge Sammy Jo uscire di soppiatto dalla stanza da letto di Steven e conclude erroneamente, che abbiano trascorso la notte insieme.

programme.title: Dynasty: Gelosia
programme.desc: Krystle perde il bambino e non può più averne altri. Jeff lascia il suo posto alla ColbyCo Oil e va a lavorare per la Denver Carrington. Sebbene Steven cominci a frequentare Sammy Jo, dichiara a Claudia di essere innamorato di lei.

programme.title: Dynasty: Intrighi internazionali
programme.desc: Blake e Jeff cercano di trovare un accordo con Rashid Ahmed, ricco sceicco e invischiato nella crisi petrolifera in Medio Oriente. Alexis va a Roma per incontrare Rashid, con il pretesto di aiutare Blake.

programme.title: Dynasty: Una foto compromettente
programme.desc: Mentre è in viaggio per Roma, Blake riesce a convincere Krystle a entrare in terapia con Nick. Fallon confessa a Jeff che l'unica ragione per la quale è rimasta incinta è perché era in competizione con Krystle e che, in più, non lo ha mai amato.

programme.title: Dynasty: Un matrimonio imprevisto
programme.desc: Jeff comincia a sospettare che Fallon lo abbia sposato in seguito al prestito che suo zio ha fatto a Blake. Chiede chiarimenti a Cecil, ma non ottiene risposte. Nonostante sia sconvolta dalle foto di Blake e Alexis, Krystle non cede alla corte di Nick.

programme.title: Dynasty: L'esplosione
programme.desc: Quando Steven e Sammy Jo annunciano a Fallon, Alexis e Krystle di essersi sposati, le donne dimostrano poco entusiasmo. Jeff e Fallon sono seriamente intenzionati a divorziare, ma Blake li convince a cambiare idea.

programme.title: Dynasty: Cecità
programme.desc: In seguito all'attentato a Blake, e alla sua cecità temporanea, Krystle decide di non dirgli della sua decisione di divorziare da lui. Anche Steven ha difficoltà a dire a suo padre che si è sposato con Sammy Jo, ma alla fine prende coraggio.

programme.title: Dynasty: Una lettera anonima
programme.desc: Blake scopre che il fratello di Nick Toscanni lavorava per la Denver-Carrington. Alexis si offre per aiutare Fallon contro Krystle e riconquistare Nick ma la ragazza rifiuta. Blake riceve una lettera anonima.

programme.title: Dynasty: Misteri e ricatti
programme.desc: Dopo aver apertamente accusato il dottor Toscanni di volersi vendicare di lui per la morte di suo fratello, Blake lo rivela anche a Krystle. Furiosa, la donna rompe con Nick.

programme.title: Dynasty: Drammatico epilogo
programme.desc: Cecil Colby, irritato con Blake perché vuole adottare Jeff, chiede aiuto ad Alexis e i due finiscono a letto insieme. Durante un party in onore di Steven e Sammy Jo, Krystle ascolta una conversazione tra Nick e Fallon.

programme.title: Dynasty: Un bambino in pericolo
programme.desc: Fallon viene ricoverata in ospedale e, dopo varie complicazioni, dà alla luce un maschietto. Il bambino è molto debole e ha poche probabilità di sopravvivere. La ragazza è inoltre molto abbattuta dopo aver saputo di non essere figlia di Blake.

programme.title: Dynasty: Genitori e figli
programme.desc: Fallon è sempre più abbattuta e rifiuta di vedere suo figlio. Alexis intanto fa pressione su Tony affinché questi ritratti ciò che ha detto a Krystle riguardo al giorno dell'incidente della donna, causato dalla stessa Alexis.

programme.title: Dynasty: Minaccia a mano armata
programme.desc: Fallon e il suo bambino tornano a casa Carrington. La donna comunica alla servitù che Alexis è persona non gradita e non vuole che faccia visita a lei e a suo figlio. Blake dice ad Alexis che ha intenzione di fare un test di paternità.
