programme.desc: When Eliza reunites with a Siberian Tiger, she is stunned when the tiger turns on her. Eliza's visiting Grandma Sophie helps her overcome her fears just as she is overcoming her own.

programme.title: The Wild Thornberrys
programme.desc: When Donnie kidnaps an aye-aye for a pet, Eliza must return the bad luck omen to his home before the villagers hunt it down.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: Strange neighbors suddenly appear across the street and Dog, obsessed with sci-fi comic books, thinks that they are aliens from outer space. After staying up all night, Dog is sound asleep on the day CatDog are to be interviewed for a TV show.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: Cat tries out for the musical theater production of Abe Lincoln: Superstar! but is dismayed when Dog inadvertently gets the lead role. Dog discovers that another canine has tresspassed upon his favorite fire hydrant.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Just Say CatDog Sent YA /Dog's Strange Condition
programme.desc: Dog is dismayed to learn that his favorite milkbones are banned from Nearburg. Dog eats too many pecan pies and a pecan tree begins to grow in his head.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Home is Where the Dirt Is/New Leash on Life
programme.desc: CatDog go on a mission to find pesky Gopher, who has ruined Cat's vegetable garden, and stolen Dog's bones from his bone cellar. Dog's up to his old tricks again, this time chasing a landing airplane all the way to the airport.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: Cat pulls out a dusty tome, Cats Through History in order to teach Dog about feline royal treatment in Egypt. Winslow catches Cat in the act of reading Dog's diary and blackmails him into becoming his personal slave.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Smarter Than the Average Dog/Catdog Doesn’t Live Here Anymore
programme.desc: Frustrated Cat buys Dog educational videos to smarten him up. Winslow wakes up one morning to find CatDog gone.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Send In The CatDog/Fishing for Trouble/Fetch
programme.desc: Dog drags Cat to Clown College, where our heroes are confronted by the stern Sgt. Sillybells, who leads the recruits in Drill Sergeant manner./Dog wins a goldfish at the county fair, which he names Veronica.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: The Lady is a Shriek/Dog the Mighty
programme.desc: In an effort to get Dog to notice her, Greaser Dog Shriek goes to to Randolph's Charm School and House of Beauty. Dog inadvertantly saves Mayor Rancid Rabbit from being crushed by the world's largest hamburger.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Hail the Great Meow Woof/Battle of the Bands
programme.desc: Dog grabs on to his homemade kite as it flies away, dragging Cat with him./CatDog form a rock band in order to compete in the Nearburg Battle of the Bands.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: Adventures in Greaser Sitting/The Cat Club/Cat Diggety Dog
programme.desc: Cliff the Greaser Dog leaves his baby niece in Cat's care. Cat joins a Cats Only club. At the first meeting, Dog dresses up like a Cat.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: Cat sets out to beat his childhood rival, Mindy Wonderful, and be the first person to climb to the top of Mt. Nearburg. While searching in the garbage for Cat's favorite spork, CatDog, Mervis, and Mr. Sunshine become stranded.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.desc: CatDog set out to find the legendary Fred the Flying Fish. Ersatz magician The Amazing Ray saws CatDog in half, then is arrested and taken to jail.

programme.title: CatDog
programme.sub-title: The Unnatural/Dog Ate It/Dopes on Slopes
programme.desc: While playing sandlot baseball, Dog is a superstar, but Cat is humiliated. CatDog go on their very first ski run, causing havoc and mayhem on the slopes. Cat and Dog practice their cha-cha moves for the upcoming Nearburg Dance Fiesta.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.sub-title: New Bully On The Block/Phoebe Breaks A Leg
programme.desc: When a new bully comes on the block, Wolfgang feels threatened that he will lose his power over Arnold and the gang. Phoebe breaks her leg when she rescues Helga from the pathway of a speeding bus.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.sub-title: Stuck In A Tree/Rhonda Goes Broke
programme.desc: Arnold tries to help Eugene get out of a tree but gets stuck himself. After a busy day at school of boasting and fashion policing, Rhonda comes home and finds out that they are now broke and have nothing left.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Helga loses her infamous locket and it winds up in the wrong place in Arnold's house. Sid learns that germs are on just about everything people touch and becomes so psychotic about hygiene that he wears a protective suit.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: During a game of baseball, Arnold pops a fly ball and it hits Helga in the head. The knock on the head makes her goofy and causes amnesia. Grandpa is paid a visit by his old friend Jimmy, which sparks up his competitive nature.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: As the gang passes through the cemetery, Gerald tells the story of the Ghost Bride who murdered her husband-to-be when he left her at the alter and married her sister. Gerald meets Chloe, a cute girl on his block, and instantly falls head over heels.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Harold decides that he hates school and wants nothing else to do with it. But when he gets suspended and can find nothing to do at home, he tries everything he can to go back. Ernie falls in love with a beautiful magazine model.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Arnold pays his cousin Arnie a visit and it turns out to be much like being in The Twilight Zone. Wolfgang tells Chocolate Boy that if he can go two weeks without chocolate, he'll give him ten pounds of chocolate.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.sub-title: Harold And Patty Arm Wrestle/Arnold And The Rich Guy
programme.desc: Harold becomes the King Of Arm Wrestling at PS 118. At a hockey game with Grandpa, Arnold prevents an airborne puck from hitting a stranger in the head.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: The Racing Mule/Curly's Girl: Mr. Hyuhn, Ernie and Oskar combine their resources to purchase a racing horse. When Rhonda's dad buys her mother a fur coat for her birthday, the temptation is too great and Rhonda wears it to school.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: On The Lam/Family Man: Harold, Stinky, and Sid steal rockets out of the science lab at school and set them off outside an old police station. The deli shop where Mr. Hyunh works has a new owner, and he's looking for a new head chef.

programme.title: Hey Arnold!
programme.desc: Grandpa enters his packard in the classic car competition. It is admired by all until someone admires it enough to steal it. Phoebe is set to receive an award for her perfect attendance.

programme.title: Aaahh!!! Real Monsters
programme.sub-title: Monster Makeover/Airplane, a Wing and a Scare
programme.desc: Wanting a face only a monster could love, Ickis contemplates plastic surgery. Ickis, Krumm, and Oblina get folded and spindled when they get themselves trapped in a suitcase and are loaded onto a plane bound for Wisconsin.

programme.title: Aaahh!!! Real Monsters
programme.desc: Krumm sprouts a gigantic pimple. The pimple has its own personality and is a hit with the other monsters, putting the squeeze on Krumm's popularity. Monster Hunter Simon says there are real monsters in the world. But no one believes him.

programme.title: Aaahh!!! Real Monsters
programme.desc: TV's loveable Murray the Monster is undermining good ghouls everywhere, because kids aren't afraid of him. Tis the season to be scary, and Oblina, Ickis, and Krumm are happy to oblige.

programme.title: Aaahh!!! Real Monsters
programme.desc: Ickis, Oblina, and Krumm are bored when Gromble's old teacher lectures at the academy. Every boy and monster's worst fear is realized for the Gromble--his mom shows up at he academy unannounced.

programme.title: The Angry Beavers
programme.desc: Dag's intrepid super hero alter ego returns. This time a snow boarding Treeflower is roped in as his new sidekick, Goody Good Gal when he once again faces his old nemesis Baron Bad Beaver (a.k.a. Norb).

programme.title: The Angry Beavers
programme.sub-title: Legend of Big Byoo-Tox / Moron-A-Thon Man
programme.desc: Unsneaky Dag enlists the help of a big hairy guy he thinks is the elusive creature, Big Byoo-Tox, to teach him his stealthy ways so he can take a toy away from his brother Norb.

programme.title: The Angry Beavers
programme.sub-title: Legend of Kid Friendly / Silent But Deadly
programme.desc: Norb drags Dag, who doesn't want to go, to a western theme park based around the legendary Kid Friendly, the grinning gunslinger who kills ya with kindness and folksy humor.

programme.title: The Angry Beavers
programme.sub-title: Pass It On / Stump's Family Reunion
programme.desc: Daggett and Norbert accompany Stump to his family reunion because Stump is a bit leery about meeting his wood-clad kinfolk. Norb warns Dag not to embarrass him as he usually does.

programme.title: Rugrats
programme.sub-title: Angelica's in Love / Ice Cream Mountain
programme.desc: Angelica gets a crush on a new four year old boy who wears a leather jacket and rides a big wheel. As they're driving to the local ice cream place, Stu and Didi take a detour to a mini-golf course they enjoyed as kids.

programme.title: Barbie Doll Adventures
programme.desc: Barbie Doll Adventures

programme.title: Barbie Life in the City
programme.desc: Join Brooklyn Roberts in her tour of New York City!

programme.title: Monster High
programme.desc: Clawdeen dreams of opening a salon made for monsters and normies.

programme.title: Monster High
programme.desc: The ghouls travel back in time to learn about Frankie's scaritage.

programme.title: Monster High Adventures of the Ghoul Squad
programme.desc: Get ready for a voltageous time! The ghouls are back like you've never seen them before.

programme.title: Barbie Doll Adventures
programme.desc: Welcome to Doll World! A beautiful place where all dolls live and play in harmony.

programme.title: Barbie Life in the City
programme.desc: Join Brooklyn Roberts in her tour of New York City!

programme.title: Enchantimals: Finding Home
programme.desc: The girls discover a lost peacock Enchantimal and her bestie and share their homes with the newcomers.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Die Doppelgänger
programme.desc: Josh freundet sich mit Drakes Doppelgänger Drew an, und Drake wird ziemlich eifersüchtig. Er fürchtet, dass er nun bei Josh abgemeldet ist. Doch im Gegenzug freundet er sich mit Joshs Doppelgänger Jerry an.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Das Auto im Klassenzimmer
programme.desc: Drake wird beschuldigt, einem seiner Lehrer einen üblen Streich gespielt zu haben, und ihm droht nun, von der Schule zu fliegen. Dabei ist er vollkommen unschuldig. Gemeinsam mit Josh tritt er vor das Lehrerkollegium, um sich zu verteidigen.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Powerpfeffer aus Peru
programme.desc: Drake und Josh nehmen an einem Salsa-Kochwettbewerb teil, bei dem man einen Plasma-Fernseher gewinnen kann. Als sie sich weigern, Megan in ihr Team aufzunehmen, müssen sie feststellen, dass diese ihre größte Konkurrentin ist.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Andere Länder, andere Sitten
programme.desc: Josh ist außer sich vor Freude, denn seine E-Mail-Freundin Yooka aus dem fernen Eudonien will ihn besuchen kommen. Um ihr den Aufenthalt so angenehm wie möglich zu machen, empfangen die beiden sie mit einer traditionellen eudonischen Zeremonie.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Die heimliche Freundin
programme.desc: Josh ist sich sicher, dass er beim diesjährigen Wissenschaftswettbewerb an seiner Schule den ersten Preis gewinnen wird. Seine Erzrivalin Mindy Crenshaw steckt schließlich immer noch in der Klapsmühle!

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Dad auf Abwegen
programme.desc: Drake und Josh sind beunruhigt, denn ihr Dad schleicht sich immer wieder nachts aus dem Haus. Die beiden vermuten, dass er eine Affäre hat, und folgen ihm heimlich.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Pension Drake & Josh
programme.desc: Mr. und Mrs. Parker-Nichols fahren in Urlaub und lassen Drake, Josh und Megan allein zu Haus. Ein böser Fehler, wie sich schnell zeigt: Drake haut das gesamte Haushaltsgeld an einem Abend auf den Kopf.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Mädchen und andere Sorgen
programme.desc: Drake und Tori sind schon ein paar Mal miteinander ausgegangen - lang genug für Tori, um Drake überall als ihren "Freund" vorzustellen. Dem ist das aber gar nicht recht, und er beschließt, mit Tori Schluss zu machen.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Operation Helen
programme.desc: Joshs Chefin Helen hat sich ihre Augen lasern lassen und darf ihren Verband einige Tage nicht abnehmen. Josh und Drake sollen sich um sie kümmern, solange sie nichts sieht.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Die erste Begegnung
programme.desc: Drake und Josh kramen in ihrer Vergangenheit. Dabei fällt ihnen auf, dass sie sich als kleine Jungs schon einmal begegnet sein müssen - und zwar bei einem Baseball-Spiel. Damals waren sie acht Jahre alt.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Dr. Drake, bitte in den OP
programme.sub-title: Dr. Drake, bitte in den OP
programme.desc: Ausgerechnet beim Hanteln stemmen erwischt es Josh: Drake beschießt ihn mit seinem frisch erfundenen Kartoffelkatapult. Vor Schreck lässt Josh die Hantel auf seinen Fuß fallen. Jetzt muss er ins Krankenhaus, um sich operieren zu lassen.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Booob, das Schaf
programme.desc: Megan möchte unbedingt ein Haustier haben und bestellt eins im Internet. Allerdings handelt es sich um ein ausgewachsenes Schaf. Mangels Stall stellt sie "Booob" in der Garage unter.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Frauenpower
programme.desc: Josh ist aufgeregt: Seine Freundin Mindy Crenshaw will ihn bei einem gemeinsamen Abendessen ihren Eltern vorstellen. Dummerweise macht er sich schon mit seinen Begrüßungsgeschenken unbeliebt.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Der Schulfrischling
programme.desc: Drake hat Ärger in der Schule. Er soll einen jüngeren Mitschüler als Mentor begleiten. Doch als der neue "kleine Bruder" Josh lieber mag als Drake, steht Ärger ins Haus. Drake muss erfahren, dass Bruderliebe ziemlich wehtun kann.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Der neue Lehrer
programme.desc: Josh darf einige Tage lang in Megans Klasse unterrichten und Drake entdeckt vielleicht seinen neuen Drummer.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Der Kinogangster
programme.desc: Josh bekommt eine Rolle in einer Krimiserie. Da er darin den Bösewicht spielt, wird er von nun an auch im wirklichen Leben von seinen Mitmenschen für einen echten Gangster gehalten, der in der Gegend als Serientäter sein Unwesen treibt.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Papa Nichols und die Achterbahn
programme.desc: Im "Mystic Mountain"-Freizeitpark wird eine neue Achterbahn aufgestellt - der "Dämonator". Das Ding gilt als die aufregendste Achterbahn der Welt. Klar, dass Drake und Josh vom ersten Tag an dabei sein wollen.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Aliens greifen an
programme.desc: Als Drake und Josh beschließen, den Spieß umzudrehen, und die kleine Megan hereinzulegen, lässt diese die ganze Familie glauben, dass eine Alieninvasion bevorsteht.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Die Fernsehpsychologin
programme.desc: Drake und Josh streiten sich wie die Kesselflicker. Da hat Megan eine Idee: Wie wäre es, wenn die Stiefbrüder sich psychologische Beratung holen würden? Kurzerhand schickt sie die beiden Streithähne in eine Psycho-Fernsehshow.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Unterwegs nach Hollywood, Teil 1
programme.desc: Walter und Audrey sind für zehn Tage auf Kreuzfahrt, und Drake und Josh haben sturmfrei. Aber einfach nur die Füße hochlegen und Party machen, ist für die beiden nicht drin.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Unterwegs nach Hollywood, Teil 2
programme.desc: Während ihre Eltern auf Kreuzfahrt sind, bricht bei Drake und Josh das Chaos aus. Die beiden haben ihre Schwester Megan, die eigentlich zu einer Freundin nach Colorado wollte, ins falsche Flugzeug verfrachtet.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Unterwegs nach Hollywood, Teil 3
programme.desc: In Hollywood geraten Drake und Josh,die eigentlich ihre Schwester Megan suchen, ins Visier einer Geldfälscherbande.Die Ganoven haben es vor allem auf Josh abgesehen, in dessen Händen sich die Daten zur Steuerung einer gestohlenen Notenpresse befinden

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Racheakt um Hamster Hervay
programme.desc: Versehentlich schicken Drake und Josh Hamster Hervay ins Reich der Träume. Zwar ist der putzige Nager nur k.o., doch die Jungs halten ihn für tot. Reumütig beichten sie Schwesterchen Megan das Missgeschick.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Tiberius, der Schreckliche
programme.desc: Drake und Josh erklären sich bereit, übers Wochenende das Haus ihrer Englischlehrerin Mrs. Hayfer zu hüten. Nichts leichter als das, denken die beiden, schließlich sollen sie nur die Pflanzen gießen und den Hund füttern.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Mindy liebt Josh
programme.desc: Mindy gesteht Josh, dass sie ihn liebt - worauf er ziemlich verstört reagiert und sofort Drake um Rat fragt. Für Drake ist die Sache sonnenklar: Es muss sich um einen von Mindys Tricks handeln!

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Der Große Doheny
programme.desc: Drake und Josh lernen durch Zufall Henry Doheny kennen, einen einst großen und berühmten Zauberer. Leider ist er inzwischen ziemlich auf den Hund gekommen.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Josh überfährt Oprah
programme.desc: Josh hat Geburtstag, und Drake überrascht ihn mit einer großen Party - allerdings eher unfreiwillig: Denn die Party ist gar nicht für Josh, sondern für Drakes neue Freundin Tabitha.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Abendessen mit Bobo
programme.desc: Drake und Josh wollen sich ein Auto kaufen. Doch statt eines fahrbaren Untersatzes bringt Drake Bobo, den Orang-Utan des Autoverkäufers, mit nach Hause.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Ich liebe Sushi
programme.desc: Drake und Josh haben bei der TV-Sendung 'Pump My Room' eine Zimmerrenovierung für ihre Eltern gewonnen. Die beiden ahnen nicht, dass sie Betrügern auf den Leim gegangen sind - die während der Abwesenheit der Familie das gesamte Haus leer räumen.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Das Baumhaus
programme.desc: Drake und Josh haben mal wieder ganze Arbeit geleistet. Im Verein mit Schwester Megan haben die beiden ungleichen Brüder mit einer Spielzeugrakete herumgespielt und dabei so ganz nebenbei das Baumhaus auf dem Nachbargrundstück zerlegt.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Wer macht das Rennen?
programme.desc: Drake und Josh schließen eine folgenschwere Wette ab: Wer von ihnen schafft es, innerhalb einer Woche die meisten Mädchen kennen zu lernen? Drake gibt sich siegessicher, doch er hat nicht mit der süßen Carly gerechnet, in die er sich prompt verliebt.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Helikopter
programme.desc: Für Drake geht der alte Menschheitstraum vom Fliegen in Erfüllung: Er gewinnt einen Helikopter-Rundflug mit anschließendem Fallschirmsprung. Dass seine Eltern gegen die riskante Luftnummer sind, denkt Drake nicht dran.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Der Sturm
programme.desc: Drake hat am Wochenende einen Open-Air-Gig mit seiner Band. Eine willkommene Gelegenheit für Josh, mal wieder sein Organisationstalent zu demonstrieren.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Die Hochzeit
programme.desc: Tante Catherine hat angekündigt, dass sie trotz stolzen Alters von 89 Jahren noch einmal vor den Traualtar treten möchte.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Der Tanzwettbewerb
programme.desc: Josh will an einem Tanzwettbewerb teilnehmen.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Schwere Jungs
programme.desc: Drake und Josh haben sich einmal zu oft daneben benommen. Weil sie sich mit gefälschten Ausweisen als volljährig ausgegeben haben, beschließen Audrey und Walter, dass es Zeit für drastische Erziehungsmaßnahmen ist.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Josh ist fertig mit Drake
programme.desc: Weil Drake ihn mal wieder versetzt hat, verpasst Josh eine wichtige Chemieklausur. Für Josh ist damit das Maß endgültig voll. Er hat genug von Drakes Eskapaden und kündigt ihm die Freundschaft auf.

programme.title: Drake & Josh: Cool, ich werde sechzehn
programme.desc: Thornton lädt Drake und Josh auf eine MTV-Geburtstagsshow ein. Doch bevor es richtig losgeht, sind die Brüder auch schon wieder draußen. Drake kann nämlich nicht mehr an sich halten und küsst Thorntons Freundin - prompt folgt die Ausladung.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: Phoebe's unborn baby begins to show signs of demonic powers as it begins to take control of her body and attack Paige and anyone else who might be a threat to it.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: Phoebe is irritated with the lack of attention of Cole and destroys five of his demons in a couple of days.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.sub-title: We're Off To See The Wizard
programme.desc: Piper and Paige team up with a magical Wizard to stop the coronation of a new Source, not realizing that the new head of the Underworld is Cole and Phoebe is his Evil Queen-to-be.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: The Charmed Ones fight a vampire queen who kidnaps Paige and tries to turn her against Piper and Phoebe.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: After 60 years of searching, two ghosts who fought with Leo in WWII come after him seeking revenge for old wounds. When they turn this wrath on his loved ones and kill Piper, Phoebe and Paige face the horror of losing another sister.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: The Seer blends a potion in chocolates to Cole give to Phoebe and conceive a son in the full moon night.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: The Seer foresees that the son of Phoebe and Cole will be very powerful, and The Source, who possessed Cole's body, must bring him to the evil side marrying Phoebe in the dark way, i.e., in a cemetery with a dark priest and drinking the bride's blood.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: Phoebe has a strange sensation about Cole, and she casts a spell to know whether she should marry him or not, bringing unexpectedly an innocent Phoebe from her childhood and a bitter Phoebe from the future to help in her decision.

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: When The Seer foresees the demise of The Source by the Halliwell sisters, he decides to break the covenant between good and evil unleashing the ultimate power, the forbidden The Hollow

programme.title: Charmed
programme.desc: Phoebe is serving on a jury in a murder case, and she is convinced that the defendant is guilty. However, when she touches the murder weapon, she has a premonition of the real killer, who has a Medusa tattooed in his right arm.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck Season Eve
programme.desc: Tomorrow is the opening day of Duck Season and the men are carrying on their tradition of camping on the Robertson Land the night before.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Can't Hardly Weight
programme.desc: Gearing up for his high school reunion, Willie realizes that he could stand to lose a few pounds. Jase and Korie set out to help him drop some weight and the strenuous battle of man-versus-waistline begins.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Shot Thru The Heart
programme.desc: The guys learn from Willie that John Luke is going through his first break up. In order to make him feel better the men decide to take John Luke hunting for nutria, and impart their relationship wisdom.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Here Lizard, Lizard
programme.desc: When the warehouse guys new office pet (a lizard) escapes, they try all they can in order to catch the wily reptile. Proving impossible, the guys finally decide to bring in the big guns to help trap it--Mr. Phil Robertson.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Hallu-Si-Nations
programme.desc: With Willie out-of-town, the guys decide to flake off work and leave to brush up the duck blinds on the Robertson land. While out, Si believes he spots what he thinks is the infamous 'Black Panther'.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Let's Go Hunting, Deer
programme.desc: Willie and Jase invite Korie and Missy along on a deer hunt because they believe their wives have become too "city." At Phil and Kay's, Miss Kay decides she wants to frame Phil's original blueprints from the first duck call he created.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Tickets To The Fun Show
programme.desc: During Duck Commander's "Casino Night" party, Si Robertson wins the grand prize of $2000 and decides to buy a massage chair for the duck call room. The massage chair becomes a detriment to the workflow, so Willie takes Si around for a replacement prize.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck Be a Lady
programme.desc: Sadie, has a homecoming dance coming up, but Willie doesn't approve of her dress selection. Willie decides to take Sadie out to find her a new "appropriate" dress.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Ring Around the Redneck
programme.desc: Though Jase lost his wedding ring long ago, Missy decides it's time for Jase to replace it with a new one. When Jase is duck hunting, once again, he loses the ring.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Bass Man Standing
programme.desc: The Duck Commander team is invited to unveil a wing of the local Bass Pro shop that will feature their products.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: With the ice road melting at a quickening rate, the truckers reflect on their first season tackling the treacherous roads of the Arctic. At the start of the season, these veteran drivers from the south were nothing more than Arctic rookies.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Hugh and Eric are neck-in-neck in their race to claim dominance over the ice road, but with only days before the end of the season, time is running out and the ocean waters are closing in.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Sit down with the men of "Season 2" who dare to drive over the frozen ocean and river waters of the Arctic, and learn why they risk their lives for the job.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: It's week two on the frozen tundra and the name of the game is Rig Move. MGM is breaking down camp and moving every last piece of equipment to a new base at Langley to continue exploring for natural gas.

programme.title: Ice Road Truckers
programme.desc: Day 1 of the new Ice Road season begins. There are 6,000 loads of freight to move in just 12 weeks to the oil camps of Alaska's North Slope. The 400 plus miles stretch from Fairbanks to the remote outpost of Deadhorse.

programme.title: Ax Men
programme.desc: The mountain seeks its revenge. Weather traps R&R's helicopter pilot in the fog. Trees fight back against Pihl's timber fallers.

programme.title: Ax Men
programme.desc: The tables are turned and the mountain's underdogs get their chance. Jimmy Smith finds the holy grail of underwater logs when he attempts to pull a dock out of the water. The men of Pihl Logging battle the biggest timber of their careers.

programme.title: Ax Men
programme.desc: Dead weight must be shed. Inexperienced hook tender Jesse Browning, junior pilot Steve Smith and greenhorn Brad Hewitt all have their heads on the chopping block.

programme.title: Ax Men
programme.desc: New faces are welcomed to the fraternity of men known as Ax Men. Rygaard and Conner Aviation hope their new greenhorns fare better than the last class. At Pihl, a missing cutter sends the crew on a search mission.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Si-amese Twins
programme.desc: Willie calls the team into work on a Saturday afternoon for an HR training session, but the seminar quickly dissolves from unproductive to complete disaster.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Battle of the Brothers
programme.desc: Willie's suspicious behavior from dying his beard to buying a new motorcycle, makes Jase come to the conclusion that Willie is having a mid-life crisis.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Aloha, Robertsons!
programme.desc: After all their hard work, Willie decides to take the entire Robertson clan on a family vacation to Hawaii. But Willie's daily itinerary for the trip gets constantly undermined by the family's desire to participate in their own island activities.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: Everyone comes together to plan a surprise wedding for Phil and Kay, setting up a special ceremony on their land, which the whole family attends. Si distracts Phil and Kay by taking them on a "trip down memory lane".

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Boxen
programme.desc: Nach mehreren Prügelattacken bietet Mr. Thurman Chris an, ihm Boxen beizubringen. Chris soll als Sparringpartner in den Ring. Zögerlich willigt er ein.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Gras
programme.desc: Zur falschen Zeit am falschen Ort: Chris wird von TJ, der gerade auf der Flucht vor der Polizei ist, ein Beutel mit Marihuana zugesteckt. Chris, den TJ noch bedroht hat, schmeißt den Beutel nicht weg, sondern nimmt ihn mit in die Schule.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Fahrerflucht
programme.desc: Chris ist vom Sportwagen des Hausmeisters restlos begeistert. Für fünf Dollar darf er sich sogar hinters Lenkrad setzen. Doch dann passiert das Unvorhersehbare: Er überfährt Greg, der sich dabei ein Bein bricht.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst sein erstes Auto
programme.desc: Chris kann nun endlich mit sechzehn Jahren seinen Führerschein machen - zu seinem Glück fehlt ihm nur noch ein Auto, das er sich von gesparten 300 Dollar von seinem Onkel Michael kauft.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Krach mit Mom
programme.desc: Der Haussegen bei Chris hängt schief. Die Situation eskaliert sogar so weit, dass Chris, ohne ein Wort zu verlieren, auszieht.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst das Mädchen von nebenan
programme.sub-title: Chris hasst das Mädchen von nebenan
programme.desc: Chris will eine Freundin - was liegt da näher, als es bei der Nachbarstochter Tasha zu versuchen. Sie willigt in die Beziehung ein, führt sie jedoch nach ihren Vorstellungen. Bis es Chris reicht.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Bombendrohungen
programme.desc: Chris bekommt von Mr. Thurman einen Denkzettel, als er in seinem Unterricht einen Witz erzählt hat. Er soll die Amtsantrittsrede von William Henry Harrison auswendig lernen, die als längste Rede eines Präsidenten in die Geschichte eingegangen ist.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst die zehnte Klasse
programme.desc: Chris' Versetzung ist gefährdet. Nicht aufgrund schlechter Noten, sondern weil er regelmäßig zu spät kommt. Mrs. Morello macht Nägel mit Köpfen, als sich Chris trotz aller Drohung erneut verspätet. Chris schmeißt daraufhin die Schule.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst seine Schuhe
programme.desc: Der 13-Jährige Chris wünscht sich nichts mehr als ein richtig cooler Teenager zu werden. Leider scheint das nicht ganz leicht zu sein. Nach dem Umzug seiner Familie, muss er sich auf seiner neuen, überwiegend von Weißen besuchten Schule zurechtfinden.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Liebeskummer
programme.desc: Chris ist unheimlich verknallt in die hübsche Keisha. Sein Herz zerbricht als er zufällig mitansehen muss wie diese seinen kleinen Bruder Drew küsst...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Basketball
programme.desc: Chris soll im Basketballteam seiner Schule mitspielen. Erst wehrt er sich dagegen, denn er ist alles andere als eine Sportskanone. Er ändert seine Meinung erst als er bemerkt, dass Basketballspieler ziemlich beliebt sind...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Nachsitzen
programme.desc: Nachdem sich das Gerücht verbreitet hat, dass sich Chris mit dem Schrecken der Schule, Joey, angelegt hat, wird er vom Direktor zum Nachsitzen verdonnert...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Fahrraddiebe
programme.desc: Trotz der Warnungen seiner Eltern verleiht Chris sein Fahrrad an einen Jungen. Dieser haut sofort damit ab und Chris steht vor der Frage wie er das seinen Eltern erklären soll....

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Halloween
programme.desc: Um seine Angebetete zu beeindrucken, beschließt Chris auf eine richtig coole Halloweenparty zu gehen, obwohl seine Mutter ihn ausdrücklich darum gebeten hat, auf seine kleinen Geschwister aufzupassen...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst den Babysitter
programme.desc: Vater Julius und Mutter Rochelle wollen endlich mal wieder einen romantischen Abend zu zweit verbringen und engagieren eine Babysitterin, die derweilen auf Chris, Drew und Tonya aufpassen soll. Doch diese ist alles andere als verantwortungsbewusst...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst den Waschsalon
programme.desc: Chris muss mit seinen jüngeren Geschwistern in den Waschsalon gehen, während sich die Eltern einen neuen Fernseher kaufen wollen. Es kommt wie es kommen muss: Auf mysteriöse Art und Weise geht die Wäsche im Salon verloren...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Lebensmittelkarten
programme.desc: Eigentlich ist es ein großes Glück für die Familie, als Vater Julius Lebensmittelmarken im Wert von 200 Dollar findet. Mutter Rochelle ist es allerdings ziemlich peinlich, mit diesen im Supermarkt zu bezahlen...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst den Schrank
programme.desc: Chris ist total genervt von seiner Schwester und beschließt bei seinem Freund Greg abzuhängen.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Weihnachten
programme.desc: Weihnachten steht kurz bevor, doch so richtig freuen kann sich die Familie nicht, denn so wie es aussieht werden Weihnachtsgeschenke in diesem Jahr finanziell nicht drin sein...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Nachtarbeit
programme.desc: Chris will unbedingt eine neue Lederjacke haben. Da die Familie nicht genug Geld hat, beschließt Chris' Vater seinen Sohn mit auf seine Arbeit zu nehmen, wo dieser sich das Geld selbst erarbeiten soll. Doch das ist gar nicht so einfach...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst sein Schulfoto
programme.desc: In Chris' Schule sollen bald die alljährlichen Klassenfotos geschossen werden. Hierfür bgekommt er extra ein ganz neues Outfit geschenkt. Leider kann er sich nicht lange darüber freuen...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst den Valentinstag
programme.desc: Chris kann sich am Valentinstag nicht so richtig freuen, denn er bekommt lediglich einige „Ich hasse dich“-Karten geschenkt.

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst die Lotterie
programme.desc: Chris' Eltern spielen unheimlich gern Lotto. Als Chris einen Lotto-Schein für sie kaufen soll, geht jedoch alles wieder mal ordentlich in die Hose...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst die Gicht
programme.desc: Vater Julius ist schwer an der Gicht erkrankt, hütet das Bett und guckt eine Soap nach der anderen. Währenddessen versucht Chris eine schlechte Note im Mathetest vor seinen Eltern zu verheimlichen...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Trauerfeiern
programme.desc: Chris lernt die wirklich tragischen Seiten des Lebens kennen, als sein geliebter Opa ganz plötzlich verstirbt und sich seine Mutter so merkwürdig verhält, dass er sie kaum wiedererkennt...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst seine Schule
programme.desc: Chris ist es leid an seiner Schule ständig gehänselt zu werden. Kurzerhand beschließt er etwas zu unternehmen, damit er von der Schule geschmissen wird...

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Karate

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst den Playboy

programme.title: Alle hassen Chris: Chris hasst Windpocken

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: L'énigme
programme.desc: Un chauffard renverse Andrea avant de prendre la fuite. Tout porte à croire qu'il conduisait une voiture volée.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Gendarme ou voleur ?
programme.desc: Samir retrouve Laura, une ancienne élève de l'école de police, à l'occasion d'une enquête liée aux vols de voitures de luxe pour le compte d'une société d'assurances. Elle est toujours la première sur le lieu de crime et sème le doute.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: La reine mère
programme.desc: La mère de Grandberger vient rendre visite à son fils. Celui-ci vient la chercher à la gare à bord de son véhicule de patrouille. Lors du retour, il doit intervenir sur un accident. Sur les lieux, sa mère ramasse par mégarde un document très dangereux.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: A chacun sa loi
programme.desc: Berg et Rehder, deux policiers, ont perdu une collègue lors d'une intervention. Des meurtres sont perpétrés. Les victimes sont des trafiquants de drogue, des délinquants relâchés par la justice, des avocats ainsi que des magistrats véreux.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Faux amis
programme.desc: Un étudiant de la faculté de sport meurt subitement à la suite d’un accident de voiture. On retrouve sur lui des petits cachets bleus.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Plein gaz
programme.desc: Une Pontiac noire provoque un accident. La course-poursuite s'annonce difficile pour Samy et Jan car la voiture ne cesse de les distancer. L'enquête les oriente rapidement vers le milieu très fermé des adeptes du tuning.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Chantage à la bombe
programme.desc: Une jeune femme meurt devant Sami, après l'explosion d’une camionnette piégée. Le maître chanteur menace de faire sauter d'autres bombes si on ne lui verse pas la somme de deux millions d'euros.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Un voisin suspect
programme.desc: Lambertz, un commissaire à la retraite, s'intéresse tant à son nouveau voisin que celui-ci menace de porter plainte. Lorsque Lambertz échappe à une tentative d'assassinat dans les locaux de son voisin, Tom et Sami prennent l'affaire au sérieux.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Un jour héroïque
programme.desc: Boris et Henri interrompent un étrange trafic entre trois hommes et se font tirer dessus. Pris en chasse par Tom et Sami, deux des criminels réussissent à prendre la fuite mais abandonnent le véhicule et leur précieuse marchandise.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Des vacances perturbées
programme.desc: « VW24 Markus », voilà ce que prononce un homme blessé dans un carambolage sur l'autoroute, avant de tomber dans le coma. Ces quelques mots vont venir perturber les vacances de nos deux agents.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Trafic sauvage
programme.desc: Tom et Sami découvrent un trafic d'animaux exotiques. Très vite, leur enquête les conduit aux services des douanes, où l'un des employés semble avoir des pratiques douteuses.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Cobra en danger
programme.desc: Boris Bonrath a demandé à l'un de ses amis, propriétaire d'une petite entreprise de bus, d'emmener l'équipe de Cobra 11 au tournoi de bowling auquel elle doit participer. Alors que le véhicule est sur l'autoroute, les freins du bus ne répondent plus.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Revanche explosive
programme.desc: Plusieurs semi-remorques sont volés en peu de temps. Tom et Sami enquêtent sur cette affaire avec le savant Armand.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Jouer avec le feu
programme.desc: Le pompier Matthias Jaspers meurt au volant de sa voiture, dans un accident de la route. L'enquête sur son décès oriente les policiers sur une série d'incendies. Jaspers était-il sur une piste ou bien était-il complice ?

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Trop forte tentation
programme.desc: Deux jeunes en liberté conditionnelle sont affectés à l'entretien des autoroutes. À la suite d’un accident, ils trouvent une mallette contenant beaucoup d'argent et un CD sur lequel figurent des informations importantes.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Froide vengeance
programme.desc: Sami et Andrea sont témoins d'un braquage dans une station-service. Au cours de la poursuite, les choses tournent mal et Andrea est obligée d'abattre un des voleurs avant qu'il ne tue Sami.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Acte de courage
programme.desc: Joël, le fils de Bonrath, travaille comme chauffeur de limousine. La petite amie de l'un de ses clients est maltraitée par celui-ci et Joël demande conseil à Sami et à Tom qui recommandent d'agir au plus vite.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Partie de chasse
programme.desc: Un jeune informaticien est assassiné sur l'autoroute. Son associé, Mike, est soupçonné du meurtre. Les preuves contre lui sont accablantes.

programme.title: Alerte Cobra un duo explosif: Délit de fuite
programme.desc: La jeune soeur de la commissaire Engalbert a causé un grave accident sur l'autoroute en essayant d'échapper à deux hommes masqués et armés. Si l'agression n'est pas prouvée, elle risque d'être condamnée pour délit de fuite.

programme.desc: Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Darkness At The End Of The Tunnel
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Rome, searching for the mysterious Enrique. Scoffing at their Beyblade challenge, Enrique decides he'd rather spend the day with some of his lady-friends. But Tyson soon convinces him to 'Let it rip!' And after seeing Enrique's personalized BeyStadium, and his outrageous bit-beast, there's a good chance that Tyson may regret his actions'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Unwilling to let his initial defeat to Enrique faze him, Tyson gets busy reworking his Beyblade. With Enrique having doubts about his own technique, and Oliver visiting him in Rome from France, the stage is set for a rematch. This time, Tyson pits the two heads of Enrique's Bit Beast Amphilyon against each other, and saves Enrique's life when Amphilyon turns on him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Enrique and Oliver decide to take our heroes on a dirigible ride to visit Robert's castle. The reason - Tyson hopes to avenge an earlier loss to Robert that happened onboard the ship coming to Europe. Tyson's patience, however, is tested when they have to sit and wait for their host who is 'not to be disturbed.' So, Tyson decides to find Robert on his own and ends up getting lost in the medieval castles many eerie secret passages. Finally everyone converges in the room where Robert is playing chess against Johnny and it's here where Tyson throws down the gauntlet and challenges Robert to a rematch. Robert refuses and goes into a whole history lesson about how 'once you've defeated your enemy, the battle is over.' Meanwhile, the arrogant little Johnny decides to pick a battle with the most-worthy opponent in the room and chooses Kai. As the fight begins, it appears to be even, but then Johnny calls out his Bit Beast Salamulyon and totally destroys him. In the end, the Bladebreakers resolve that they have their work cut out for them to become the world champion Beybladers!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers have made themselves at home at Robert's mansion, refusing to leave unless the Europeans agree to a final Beybattle. To teach his guests a lesson, Robert agrees to a match at his new stadium. But there's one condition: If the Bladebreakers lose, they have to forfeit their berth at the world Championship. Ray and Oliver battle fiercely and the first round ends in a tie. Johnny and Kai, bitter rivals, step to the bowl. But can Kai defeat the man who defeated him?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Match two gets underway at the Olympia Coliseum, and with a little unsolicited help by his teammates, Kai walks away with a win. The match is tied and the Majestics grudgingly admit to themselves that the only way they'll win the contest is to fight as a team, as the Bladebreakers do. Facing off against Tyson in the final match, will Robert be able to apply the fundamentals of teamwork? And will the Bladebreakers ever discover who sent them on their cross-Europe trip in the first place'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: Hot Battle In A Cold Town
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Moscow on a brisk winter's day in anticipation of the World Beyblading final tournament. As they search for their hotel in the chilly city, they happen upon Boris, a strange man who claims to be the head of a rather eerie Beyblading training center. With the charm of an old world count, Boris invites them to lunch and them brings them to the training facility where they meet the next generation of Beybladers. It's here where Boris decides that one of his pupils should test his blading skills against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers run into some old friends in Russia when The All-Starz and the White Tiger Clan show up for an exhibition match. The Beybattle between the two teams ends in a tie and they become fast friends, except for Emily and Mariah, who refuse to speak to each other. Meanwhile, Kai returns to the Abbey to find out why it fills him with foreboding. He discovers a cruel Beyblade facility in the Sub-basements, housing twisted science experiments and an army of children being molded into deadly Beybladers. Kai's lost memories come flooding back as he realizes he was raised in the abbey. But has he discovered the truth too late?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kai is torn between escaping the Abbey, and exploring it further in an attempt to unlock forgotten memories from his childhood. The Bladebreakers track down their missing teammate to the Abbey, but are denied access by two of its wunderkind bladers. When Kai discovers the existence of Black Dranzer, the world's most powerful Beyblade, Boris offers it to him - but only if Kai quits the Bladebreakers forever and rejoins the Biovolt Corporation. Flooded with memories of using Black Dranzer as a child, and the lure of its dark, corrupting power leads Kai to a shocking decision.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the first day of the Beyblade World Championships in Moscow, and as our heroes leave their hotel, they still haven't been able to locate Kai who's been missing for some time. Regardless, they arrive at the tournament and meet up with both the White Tigers and the All Starz who invite them to watch their first match against the Demolition Boys. At first things seem fairly normal, that is, until they start to battle. Things go from bad to worse for the All Starz who are no match for the Demolition Boys who quickly go up 2-0 in the best of five events. In the next match, Michael has to square off against a mystery member of the Demolition Boys and it turns out to be none other than Kai who has defected from the Bladebreakers. In the final battle, Kai takes on all the All Starz at once' and wins!! After his victory, he commands the All Starz Bit Beasts to enter his blade and he announces to the world that he now possesses the most powerful Beyblade in the world!!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Determined to avenge the All-Starz' devastating defeat, the White Tigers face Kai in the Tournament. One by one, they fall before the power of Black Dranzer and watch, horrified, as their Bit Beasts are absorbed into Kai's Beyblade. The Bladebreakers storm the abbey in a desperate attempt to free their teammate. Tyson stumbles into Biovolt's secret lab and learns the truth about Kai's past from a gloating Boris. Tyson refuses to give up on his friend until Kai hands over his old Beyblade and tells him to leave. Will the Bladebreakers survive the loss of their most powerful member?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Downtrodden and dejected, the Bladebreakers ask themselves over and over again: 'Why would Kai betray us?' Soon enough, however, the boys get a chance to ask him themselves. Summoned by Kai to Beyblade on a frozen lake, the Bladebreakers must not only win to save their Bit Beasts, but must convince Kai that they will always be his teammates. Can they do it'?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Now that Kai is finally loyal to the 'Bladebreakers,' he returns the Black Dranzer to Boris, doing severe damage to the enemy headquarters in the process. Voltaire orders the operation to proceed, and Boris brings in the Demolition Boys to get the job done. It is revealed that BioVolt is creating a breed of powerful, savage, Bit-Beasts that are designed for War'and the plan is to use them to take over the entire World. The Demolition Boys attack the BBA bus, and Max bravely battles to save his friends. Unfortunately he loses his Bit-Beast, Draciel, in the process'.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are stranded on the barren Russian Tundra after their run-in with the Demolition Boys when the Majestics mysteriously show up in their bus. After picking our heroes up, they stop at an abandoned palace where Robert challenges Tyson to battle. At first it seems strange that Robert would do this, but Tyson accepts and a battle ensues with Tyson losing two straight. He becomes infuriated! Robert then tells Tyson that he must harness his power back into his blade, which totally confuses Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The World Championship Finals are finally here and Kai insists on Beybattling first, hoping his knowledge of the Demolition Boys will give him an advantage over Spencer. But in the first set, Seaborg, Spencer's whale Bit Beast, uses the water in the Black Sea Bowl to create a tsunami, which overwhelms Dranzer. Kai is desperate for victory and Voltaire makes him a tempting offer: the power of Black Dranzer in exchange for betraying his friends and stealing their Bit Beasts. Kai stays true to his heart and resists his grandfather.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After Kai's first round loss to the Demolition Boys in the World Beyblade Finals, it's Ray's turn to take on Bryan in a best-of-three match. Ray learns the hard way that Bryan is a nasty competitor who'll do anything to win - including putting Ray himself through the ringer. When it's discovered that Bryan's attack includes the ability to manipulate air itself into a weapon, Ray faces a troubling realization. To negate Bryan's fury, he must put his own well being at risk. But Ray's Bit-Beast Driger has other ideas, and it offers up selfless act of its own.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After a devastating match puts Ray in the hospital, Tyson trains his heart out to prepare for his battle against Tala, leader of the Demolition Boys. What Tyson doesn't know is that Tala has become one of Boris' weird experiments, uploaded with dangerous Biovolt technology. Meanwhile, Max's parents work together to come up with an improved Beyblade that can combat the existing threat of the Demolition Boys' prowess. Can it even come close to competing against'Cyber-Tala?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It is the finals of the World Beyblading Championships in Moscow with Tala from the Demolition Boys and Tyson tied at one game a piece in the best of three finals. With the victory, the tide has turned in favor of Tala who warps the two warriors into a giant iceberg where there is no contact with the outside world. The second battle begins, and it takes little time for Tala to combine his multiple Bit Beasts into one and take the lead in the best of three finals. Meanwhile, the evil Voltaire, head of the Biovolt Corporation looks on and begins celebrating the victory, which translates into his domination of the corporate world.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is back home from just winning the World Beyblade Championships and he thinks he's one hot dude!! But after disrupting his homeroom at school, he's punished with a detention which makes him late for a local tournament. When he finally get there, he's confronted with a mystery kid, Mister X, who battles his way to the finals to face off against Tyson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Kenny learns that the cloaked Blader named Ozuma, who defeated Tyson in an informal, Supermarket-sponsored Beybattle, was using an invisible Bit-Beast. Tyson demands a rematch against the strange opponent ' and loses for a second time when Dragoon mysteriously fails to appear on command. Effects from the battle damaged Dizzi, whom Kenny endeavors to repair. Meanwhile, a group of shady Men in Black have been busy monitoring Tyson and Ozuma the entire time. At school, tensions between Tyson and Hilary continue to rise.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson still can't get over losing his town's Beyblade Tournament to the mysterious Mister X. Kenny and Dizzi try to come up with some answers but discover a greater mystery. On the same day as Tyson's loss, Max and Ray were also visited by similar shadowy figures that defeated them as well. While Tyson does his best to avoid his school chores, Kenny makes a startling discovery about Mister X's Beyblade. Unfortunately Tyson, unaware of this new information, unexpectedly runs into Mister X at the park and challenges him to a rematch!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson heads to the park to meet Kenny, who has a plan to get Dragoon back 'on line'. But when Kenny and Hilary are kidnapped, Tyson is forced to jump through a series of hoops set out by their captors, which test his speed and determination. After successfully completing their orders, Tyson finds himself on a ship equipped with a fancy computer system ' and his friends, locked in a glass-walled cage. But what do the kidnappers want ' and how far will they go to get it?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny are safe on dry land once again but are totally baffled trying to figure out why Kenny and Hilary were kidnapped by two mystery men. The best that they can deduce is that two factions are out to steal the Bit Beasts of all the members of the BladeBreakers. This leads them to wonder about Kai who supposedly has retired.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Inside Gideon's training center two of his henchmen discover a talented Blader named Snakey and offer to equip his Blade with the Magtram. The Magtram is a device that creates a magnetic field around the user's Beyblade and gives an unfair advantage to anyone using it. Kenny and Hilary are on the look out for their mysterious captors when Tyson shows up with a new scheme to find Ozuma. Out of nowhere, Snakey shows up and challenges Tyson to a match.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Kenny try to determine what the mystery material was inside Snakey's Beyblade that made it so magnetic. Kai is tight-lipped after rejoining his friends following his draw against Dunga. Kai crashes at Tyson's place, but departs quickly after old grievances resurface, and Hilary suspects him of being a spy. Tyson and Kenny e-mail Max's Mom, asking for help with their analysis of the mystery metal, while Hilary suggests visiting another person who could help them - Mr. Dickenson.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: At long last, Max and Ray rejoin their friends and the Bladebreakers are back together again! Just in time to meet their opponents, Team Psykick. With one week to train, the guys have victory on their brains ' especially after Max and Kenny reveal the new technology developed by Max's mom. The MG Core produces a magnetic field similar to the one in the Magtram technology, giving the user optimal control over their Beyblade and increasing the Beyblades power ten fold. However, it's not an easy thing to control, and the guys have a rough start.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers were on route to take on Team Psykick in a tournament when the Driver filled the bus with sleeping gas. While unconscious, they were quickly whisked away to a deserted island where Doctor B, Gideon's minion, was assigned to steal the Bit Beasts from all four team members with a Bit-Beast Capturing System.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers are trapped on a mysterious island and not sure how to get off, so they decide to split up. Hilary, Kai and Kenny head for the lighthouse where they hope to find a way to communicate with the outside world and call for help, while Tyson, Ray and Max accidentally find themselves at the site of their next battle. Kai's gang faces difficult obstacles when their mysterious captor tries to dissuade them from reaching the lighthouse, and they barely escape in one piece.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.sub-title: The Evil Island Of Dr. B
programme.desc: Our heroes are still trapped on a deserted island and are puppets of the evil Doctor B who's intent is to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts. But he does make a deal with the kids that if each member of the Bladebreakers can defeat a member of Team Psykick, he'll release them. Only two haven't fought yet- Tyson and Kai. The first battle is between Kai and Figel that Kai wins handily. After the battle, Kenny, Kai and Hilary resume their quest to the lighthouse to get a clear satellite signal to get help from the outside. Finally they make contact, but not before they return to find Tyson in battle against another member of Team Psykick, Daryl.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson recuperates in the hospital after being rescued from the island where he fought Team Psykick. Away from school, Tyson discovers he really likes hospital life until Hilary shows up with all his homework assignments. Meanwhile Gideon, frustrated with his attempts to capture the BladeBreakers Bit Beasts, hatches a sinister new plan. He demands that Doctor B and his team create powerful Cyber Bit Beasts using the data they have gathered on the Blade Breakers. The only problem is their data is incomplete.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Joseph of the Saint Shields infiltrates the Psykick's laboratory and discovers their latest, sinister plan. Gideon and Doctor B are using the data they collected on the Blade Breakers to create Cyber Bit-Beasts based on the ones our heroes use. But the Doctor's first test ends in disaster; the Cyber Bit Beasts aren't quite ready yet. As for the BladeBreakers, they learn that the group who've been using invisible Bit Beasts against them - the Saint Shields - are all in the vicinity.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes have been confronted by Joseph and Mariam and just as Tyson runs up, Ozuma, the Saint Shields leader, challenges Tyson to a battle. As it rages on, Tyson is forced to call out his Victory Tornado Attack in order to win. After the fight, Ozuma flippantly tells Tyson he needs to 'improve his Bit Beast Technique' which stumps Tyson to no end, especially after winning!! Meanwhile, Gideon oversees Doctor B who unveils the first ever Cyber Bit Beast which is the most powerful Beast in the world. This cloned power from the Sacred Bit Beasts has been compressed into one blade. But first it has to be tested and Gerry, one of the best Blader's Team Psykick has to offer, is chosen. His mission is to enter a local tournament and draw out the Cyber Beast in battle to see how it handles. Oddly enough, the BladeBreakers show up at the same tournament just as Gerry calls out his Bit Beast. This is when things go horribly wrong as the Beast goes totally out of control and self destructs leaving the BladeBreakers to wonder what Team Psykick are up to!!
